[Thunder Step]
Boom!
The distance closed in the blink of an eye, the white-eyed man raised his head, but it was already too late, for the first time the young Vorhelm had truly reached him.
A lightning-covered fist came toward his face, it seemed that this attack would definitely hit.
...but a wall of tissue grew between them and several meters of dense flesh and bone formed between the two of them in less than a second.
Lian’s fist went inside it, but he could not pass through all of its thickness and Ezrak’s laughter came from the other side.
"That was close!"
Lian pulled his fist out, the wall was quickly becoming thicker, a frown appeared on his face, the more time passed, the more he felt how annoying this living cave was.
No matter how much he tried, as soon as he got close to this bastard, the cave protected him in strange ways.
He had tried to freeze everything, he had tried to destroy it with lightning and he had even tried to tear them apart.
But in the end it was useless, everything he did was useless, so how was he supposed to kill this cave?
And while he was frowning, a familiar sentence echoed in his mind.
Aldric’s voice.
"When you first learn the skill, you’ll probably make a twenty-meter palm and get happy when you see it."
He looked at the huge wall, a small smile appeared on his face.
"I think he was right."
He raised his right hand, mana flowed toward his palm.
Instead of being compressed into a small space like Aldric’s version, the mana spread out from his palm.
A huge aura appeared in front of him, at first it was not in a clear shape and then it took form.
A huge palm, more than fifteen meters, and even he looked at it for a few seconds.
"Oh?!
Another new thing!!
...but why is it so big?"
Ezrak’s excited voice came from behind the wall.
"You like big?
Let’s see how different it is from a small one."
Lian pushed his palm forward and his eyes narrowed.
[Suppressing Palm]
BOOOOOOOOM!
The mana palm hit the wall.
Pressure was applied, the first meter of tissue was crushed immediately, then the second, and the bones inside the wall made a horrible sound.
Crack!
Crack!
Crack!
The entire mass that was several meters thick was pushed inward, and black liquid came out of the tissues like a fountain.
A moment later, the wall exploded from the middle and pieces of flesh and bone spread throughout the cave, and the force of the attack even pushed the white-eyed man several meters backward.
For a moment, there was silence.
The young Vorhelm looked at his own palm.
His control was terrible, a large amount of mana had been wasted, the size was much larger than what he needed.
But its power was not bad, in fact it was incredible, he had also used only a small amount of mana and this skill could make its attacks stronger or weaker depending on the amount of mana it needed.
On the other side of the ruined wall, Ezrak was lying on the ground, he had landed badly and it was clear that he was injured...it was expected that he would curse, get angry or something like that.
But a few seconds later, he started laughing, at first Lian thought it was because of anger.
But no.
The white-eyed man was genuinely happy and quickly stood up from the ground.
"Did you see?!"
Who was he talking to?
It was not clear, was he talking to him?
Or was he talking to someone else...?
"Did you see?
Did you see?
Did you see?!"
His eyes were shining with excitement.
"I was not wrong!
It became even better!
Much better!"
He started counting with his fingers in the air.
"Better bones.
Better muscles.
More mana.
More compatibility.
Stranger growth..."
He suddenly looked at Lian and his smile became wider.
"If you keep going like this, maybe I won’t even have to throw much of you away!
Everything about you is perfect!
I can combine everything about you with the Calamity Seed!
There is no useless part of your body!"
"Very kind of you."
The young Vorhelm stayed there for a moment and did not know how to answer.
"You’re welcome!"
Lian was not sure if the man had even understood the sarcasm, and the cave started moving again.
But this time he did not only defend himself, his eyes moved across the veins.
[True Sequence]
Information entered his mind.
Mana paths, nerve paths, contraction cycles, liquid distribution networks, and the points where Ezrak’s commands were turned into orders.
But there were too many of them, far too many, there were at least hundreds of paths and thousands of branches.
The structure of the cave was not like a skill that could be analyzed by looking at a few main paths.
This was a complete living creature.
Lian dodged several attacks and continued the analysis at the same time, the threads were different, but their sources of energy were connected and the different tissues worked independently.
But in the end, the energy returned to one path.
He jumped over a wall that was closing, a bone claw passed under his foot but he dodged it and landed on an icy platform.
His eyes followed the path of several huge veins, all of them went toward the center of the cave, toward the chamber and more exactly toward the Calamity Seed.
For several seconds, the entire picture came together in his mind.
Blood, nutrients, mana, fresh tissues and even the heat produced in different parts of the cave...all of them eventually reached that creature.
"I understand."
Lian looked at the huge egg.
"What?"
Ezrak, who was standing farther away, smiled.
"That when you said you built this cave for yourself, it was just a lie, wasn’t it?"
The white-eyed man’s smile stopped for a moment, but he continued.
"It isn’t even a laboratory, all of it is a womb, the real purpose of this place isn’t to protect you, this place is a womb for the Calamity Seed...like a mother’s womb for her child."
"The main purpose of this place is to protect the Seed and give it nutrients."
Ezrak said nothing, that was enough...Lian had guessed correctly.
"Now one question remains, why did you try to hide something like this?"

chapters.title: Chapter 470: The Living Cave III
paragraphs: "Now there is only one question left, why did you try to hide something like this?" Lian asked without taking his eyes off the huge egg.
Ezrak’s smile stayed still for a few seconds.
Then he raised his index finger and gently tapped his temple twice.
"Hide it? No, no... I didn’t hide it, you just finally asked the right question." He shook his head as if correcting a child’s mistake.
"What’s the difference?" The young Vorhelm raised an eyebrow, although his tone was more sarcastic and he knew that this bastard was simply hiding the truth.
The white-eyed man gave a quick look at the walls around them.
The thick veins inside the cave’s flesh were still slowly beating, and black, golden, and red fluids were moving through different paths.
"It makes a big difference, a womb doesn’t just give food, it protects, repairs, kills threats, chooses the needed materials, and keeps its child alive." He placed his hand on the living wall.
The flesh under his palm contracted like a tamed animal.
"And when it thinks its child is dying... it does some very stupid things."
"What kind of stupid things?" Lian paused at the last sentence.
"I’m not telling you." Ezrak’s smile suddenly became wider.
"Why?"
"Because you are exactly the kind of person who, if someone tells you not to touch something, the first thing you do is go and touch it."
He only looked at him for a few seconds and then let out a short sigh.
"Your understanding of my personality is very insulting."
"But it’s not wrong." The white-eyed man shrugged.
Lian said nothing, unfortunately, it really was not wrong but there was a bigger problem.
The last few minutes had proven one thing completely; cutting off the arms, destroying the organs, freezing the veins, or even burning huge parts of this cave was not enough.
This thing grew back again, every wound closed and every organ was replaced.
And if the entire cave was going to keep rebuilding itself forever, he could fight it here for several more days and in the end only waste his own mana.
So he had to find another method, besides, he felt that maybe by killing this cave he could kill that Calamity Seed as well.
His eyes stopped on one of the thick veins inside the wall.
[ True Sequence ]
The world around him did not change, but his mind began to break down the thing in front of him.
The flow of mana, nerve pulses, contraction cycles, fluid transfer paths, and the way Ezrak’s commands were received and turned into biological reactions.
Before this, he had only followed the structure of its attacks, but this time he was reading the creature itself.
Information entered his mind one after another.
One hundred paths.
Two hundred.
Five hundred.
More.
Almost every part of the cave could react independently, but ... that was exactly where the mistake was, it could react independently, but it did not have true independence.
The veins connected to larger branches, the branches connected to main paths, and the main paths eventually returned to several specific points.
Lian narrowed his eyes slightly, he had found them, three huge organs that existed in three different parts of the womb.
One was responsible for spreading blood and biological materials, one was responsible for filtering and transferring mana and the third controlled the nervous system and regeneration.
Three growth nodes.
But even they were not the highest part of the structure, the three paths came together again at a point near the Calamity Seed’s chamber.
Something else was there that was bigger and more important, and almost all vital commands passed through it.
Lian slowly smiled.
"What did you find?" Ezrak noticed immediately and suddenly felt something bad.
But he did not answer, instead he moved his right leg back, mana gathered in his legs.
The white-eyed man was still watching him when ... Boom!
[ Thunder Step ]
Lian was thrown toward the left side of the cave like a blue-purple lightning bolt.
"Oh?" Ezrak was surprised for a moment, then his smile returned almost immediately.
The living walls moved, four bone pillars came out of the floor and blocked the young Vorhelm’s path but he did not change his path, there was no need.
[ Frost Dominion ]
The air in front of him turned white. Ice spread over the bones like a wave and covered their surface in a few moments.
Lian pulled his right fist back.
[ Thunder Calamity ]
[ Glacial Reaper Claw ]
A huge ice claw formed over his hand, with lightning covering it and shining around it, and then he moved it forward.
His fist hit the first pillar.
Boom!
The ice and bone exploded together and the pieces flew through the air.
Lian passed through them and two fleshy arms came out of the wall, one toward his neck and the other toward his legs.
His body instantly turned into ash.
[ Ash Step ]
The claws passed through the ash and hit each other, and he formed again four meters ahead.
Now he was only a few steps away from the first node and he saw it behind several layers of flesh.
A nearly round mass almost three meters wide, covered in thick red veins that spread nutrients through the entire womb with every beat.
"Wait..." Ezrak finally understood and his smile disappeared, now he understood the reason for that bad feeling!
Lian placed his hand on the ground and released cold, ice passed through the skin and flesh and entered the veins connected to the first node.
"What are you doing?" The white-eyed man asked louder this time and anxiety and worry could be felt in his voice.
He did not answer, the ice reached the node.
Crack...
The red flesh began to turn white, the liquid inside it froze, the first beat slowed down, the second beat stopped halfway, and the third... never came.
The first growth node stopped moving and the entire cave shook for a moment, hundreds of veins on one side of the creature’s body became still.
"Lian!!!" Ezrak’s face changed.
But Lian not only completely ignored him, he also used that same frozen network, placed his palm on the ice and lightning crawled over his fingers.
[ Thunder Calamity ]
Krrrrrrr!
Lightning entered the ice network and the electric current jumped from one branch to another and moved through the depths of the womb like a deadly disease.
"No—" The white-eyed man opened his eyes wider.
Boom!
An explosion came from another part of the cave and the second node was not even in Lian’s field of view, but the frozen network was directly connected to it.
The lightning entered the organ from inside and the mana-filtering tissues lit up for a moment.
Then ... they burned.
Golden liquid sprayed out from several exploded veins and a large part of the cave’s blue lights suddenly went out.
"Lian!" Ezrak was no longer smiling, and that coldness had returned to his eyes, because he had understood what this boy was doing.
"Now is not the time to talk, enjoy the show." The young Vorhelm moved toward the third node without stopping.
"No, now is exactly the time to talk!" The white-eyed man raised his hands.
The entire cave reacted and a bone wall grew in front of Lian.
Then a second one.
And a third.
Each one was thicker than the one before it, as if the womb had understood what was happening but he also no longer planned to break each one with his fists.
He raised his right hand, mana was pulled toward his palm and this time the skill formed faster than the first time.
A huge aura appeared.
But not fifteen meters, rather around ten meters, this time his goal was to create a smaller but more destructive palm.
[ Suppressing Palm ]
He pushed his palm forward.
BOOOOOOM!
The huge pressure hit the three bone walls, the first one broke apart at once, the second was pushed several meters inward.
The third resisted for one second and then hundreds of its bones broke at the same time.
Crack!
Crack!
Crack!
The broken mass was pushed inward and the third node was behind it and the palm reached it without stopping.
The huge organ was crushed from every direction for a moment.
Then... Splatter!
It exploded and black and red liquid splashed across the walls and all three nodes stopped at the same time and the entire womb began to convulse.
The floor under the young Vorhelm’s feet moved up and down several times, the walls contracted and hundreds of mouths inside the flesh opened, but they made no sound.
The veins were beating in an irregular way, some parts began to die and some others desperately tried to repair themselves.
"You’re killing the womb!." And Ezrak truly looked terrified.
"You finally understood." Lian turned his head toward him.
"No, idiot!" The man’s scream spread through the entire cave and this time there was nothing childish in his voice.
"I mean you’re killing the womb itself!"
"That is exactly my goal." The young Vorhelm raised an eyebrow.
Ezrak started running but not toward Lian, instead he ran toward the center of the cave where the chamber was located.
"You don’t understand! If the womb completely dies, I don’t know what will happen to me either!"
"Didn’t you make all of this? How do you not know what will happen after that? You’re lying again." Lian paused for a moment.
"I made it, then I let it grow!" the white-eyed man said angrily and opened his hand toward the living walls.
"You think I still wrote down every single one of its instincts? Designed every single one of its responses? This thing has grown for years, changed, and learned!"
His white eyes stayed on the chamber for a moment.
"Even I don’t know everything it can do now."

chapters.title: Chapter 471: The Unborn Saint I
paragraphs: This sentence made Lian look at the egg for a second, then his eyes moved to the final path.
The central node.
If the three growth nodes were the main organs, this one was the decision-making brain of the womb, or perhaps something closer to a heart.

He did not know whether what the man had said was true or not, but either way he could not stop in the middle of what he was doing, not to mention that he was not going to let this madman complete a Calamity Seed.

There was already a Calamity responsible for everything that had happened in their world and he had no interest in letting something that had the potential to become another Calamity wander around in their world.
He moved.
"Wait!" Ezrak understood immediately and the color left his face even more.
Lian jumped over a dead vein, behind the Calamity Seed’s chamber, a huge organ could be seen.

Nearly five meters tall, a mix of white and black and its overall shape was similar to a heart, but it had several separate holes and hundreds of veins entered the walls of the egg from different parts of it.
True Sequence completed the information.
All vital messages, all regeneration commands and all growth cycles, everything passed through here.
The Birth Node.
"Found you." He quietly whispered.
"Don’t touch that!" Ezrak’s voice was so loud this time that even he froze for a moment.
"The more you tell me not to touch it, the more sure I become that I found the right place." Lian gave him a quick look.
"I’m not joking this time!"
"Neither am I."
Coldness was released from his palm.
[ Frost Dominion ]
Ice formed over the Birth Node like a new layer of skin but it did not only cover the surface, the cold went deep inside and the veins turned white one after another.
The black and golden liquid inside them froze, the huge organ tried to contract once.
It stopped halfway.
"Lian, listen! If—" The white-eyed man ran toward Lian.
An ice wall formed in front of him and he was forced to stop.
"Damn it!"
The young Vorhelm placed his palm on the frozen surface of the node, this time he did not want to create a ten-meter palm.
Size was important for beginners but density was what mattered.
Mana gathered inside his real palm, it became more compressed but a lot of it was still wasted, he was still far behind Aldric’s version.
But for the third time, it was better.
[ Suppressing Palm ]
Boom.
The sound of the impact was small, unlike what was expected, there was no huge explosion and no wall exploded.
Even the Birth Node remained almost completely intact.
Ezrak froze for a moment and Lian also lowered his hand and looked at it for a few seconds.
But then ... Crack.
The outer shell of the node cracked.
Crack... Crack... Crack...
More cracks appeared, the outer flesh still kept its shape, but everything inside had completely collapsed.
The flesh, veins and nerve paths inside it had turned into a crushed mass.
...The node had died from the inside..
"No..." The white-eyed man’s face became ugly and there was even a hint of fear in his eyes and ...the entire cave went silent.
There were no more pulses, the walls became still and the veins stopped.
The half-grown arms hanging from the ceiling remained still.
The creatures that were still moving in different parts of the womb fell to the ground at the same time.
The biological lights turned off one after another, silence covered the entire cave, as if the cave had really died.
Lian heard the real silence, he slowly breathed out, he had succeeded, at least it seemed so, but there was no notification to confirm it.
He looked around, Ezrak’s face confirmed that the womb had really died.
But the white-eyed man’s eyes were fixed directly on the egg.
Lian wanted to start talking again but suddenly something beyond both of their expectations happened.
Thump!
All the veins that should have been dead suddenly contracted, but not toward him and not to attack, instead all of them moved toward the Calamity Seed’s chamber.
The young Vorhelm narrowed his eyes and the remaining liquids throughout the womb began to move.
Blood.
Mana.
Nutrient fluids.
Stored tissues.
Even parts of the incomplete creatures that had fallen to the ground began to melt, their skin collapsed and their bones became soft.
Their bodies turned into a dark liquid and were pulled toward the chamber through the veins around them.
"This... I didn’t design this." Ezrak took one step back and his voice was so quiet that this calmness made the sentence much more frightening.
"What is happening?" Lian looked at him, from his reaction he could understand that this man was not lying.
It seemed that his decision to kill the womb had caused a chain of unexpected events that should not have happened normally.
"The womb is dying." Ezrak did not answer for several seconds, his eyes were still on the egg.
"I already understood that part."
"No."
"It has realized that the womb is dying."
The young Vorhelm became silent and Ezrak pressed his lips together.
"And if the womb can no longer keep its child alive... it is giving it everything that remains."
At that moment, the amount of liquid inside the egg began to go down.
Lian turned his eyes back, the creature inside the chamber was still unmoving but its white skin was absorbing the liquid and the liquid level was going lower every second.
One meter.
Two meters.
Golden and black veins under its skin lit up and suddenly one of its fingers moved ...
Very slightly but enough to make Ezrak freeze.
Thump!
But this sound did not come from outside ... Vorhelm placed his hand on his chest, this heartbeat had come from him.
But not from his normal heart, something deeper that was hidden deep inside his soul...the Ruined Heart.
It was only one beat but it had appeared suddenly for no reason, as if something had managed to get its attention.
Lian’s eyes opened slightly, this heartbeat was not a good sign.
"What happened?" Ezrak noticed his movement.
He did not answer because at that moment ...Thump!
This time the heartbeat came from outside and a beat came from inside the egg and this time the white-eyed man heard it too and both of them became still.
One beat from the Ruined Heart.
One beat from the creature.
Then again ...Thump!
Again this was the beat that came from inside Lian, a beat that belonged to the Ruined Heart.
Thump...!
And once again, another beat came from inside the egg.
"What is this...?" Ezrak moved his eyes between Lian and the chamber.
The young Vorhelm had no answer either and before he even had a chance to think, suddenly ...Crack!
A thin line appeared on the surface of the egg.
"No, no, no..." Ezrak took one step back.
A second crack.
A third.
A fourth.
The shell began to break and a white hand from inside was placed on the transparent surface, the first thing that could be seen was its long fingers, far too long.
Crack.
The shell broke and the hand came through it, dark liquid poured onto the ground like a waterfall.
"I... didn’t wake you...you shouldn’t wake up now..." Ezrak whispered in a low voice.
Krrrrrrk!
The shell opened from the middle and the complete creature came out.
Head.
Shoulders.
Chest.
A body nearly six meters tall, far too long, but not weak and dense muscles like white ropes could be seen under its half-transparent skin.
Golden and black veins covered its entire body.
The face had no mouth, there was no complete nose either and there was only a vertical slit from the forehead to the middle of the face.
Six long and curved bones came out from behind its head, like a holy halo or a crown that had been made from bone by mistake.
Five branches were complete and the sixth had only grown halfway, white strands of tendon, nerves and bone hung from behind its shoulders.
Like wings, but without feathers and without natural beauty, like someone who had heard about angels, had never seen one and then tried to make something similar using flesh and bone.

[ Rank: Mutated - Calamity Seed ]
[ Growth Stage: Incomplete. ]
[ Current Growth: 68%. ]

And behind it was a black eye that had neither an iris nor white, only complete darkness.
The eye first stopped on Lian and another notification appeared.

[ Absorption priority changed. ]
[ First absorption target: Lian Vorhelm. ]
But one second later the black eye moved and stopped on Ezrak and he froze for a moment.
A new notification appeared.
[ Breeder source detected. ]
[ Biological value: Extremely high. ]
[ Second absorption target: Ezrak Vahr. ]

The Unborn Saint tilted its head slightly for the first time.
"No..." Ezrak took one step back.
"I think your child really likes you." Lian gave him a quick look.
"Shut up!" Fear could be heard behind his voice.
"I shouldn’t be a target!"
"I think it has a different opinion." The young Vorhelm raised an eyebrow.
"I’m its creator! I should be able to control it!" he said while pointing at the creature.
The Unborn Saint showed no reaction, one of the five complete branches of its halo slowly lowered and sank into the dead floor of the womb.
Black veins on the bone lit up.
"No—" and the white-eyed man suddenly froze.
Lian felt something at that moment, a very powerful pressure that did not appear over the entire cave but around his own body.
The weight of his body became several times heavier.
Crack!
The ground under his feet broke and his knees bent for a moment, Predator’s Instincts screamed.
The Unborn Saint moved and took one step, but its six-meter body strangely swallowed the distance of dozens of meters.
In one moment it was in front of him and its raised hand came forward and its open fingers reached the center of his chest.
Lian immediately activated Thunder Step.
Boom!
But the pressure of the weight slowed his movement and instead of an explosive jump, he only moved a few meters to the side and the Saint’s fingers passed over his chest.
His clothes were torn and four thin lines appeared on his skin...the contact lasted less than one second but it was enough.
Thump!
The Ruined Heart beat and the Calamity Seed stopped at that exact moment and its black eye opened completely, the sixth incomplete branch behind its head ...
Crack.
It grew one centimeter.
"No..." Ezrak saw it and his fear became several times greater.
[ Emergency Quest ]

sentences.text: This sentence made Lian look at the egg for a second, then his eyes moved to the final path.
The central node.
If the three growth nodes were the main organs, this one was the decision-making brain of the womb, or perhaps something closer to a heart.

He did not know whether what the man had said was true or not, but either way he could not stop in the middle of what he was doing, not to mention that he was not going to let this madman complete a Calamity Seed.

There was already a Calamity responsible for everything that had happened in their world and he had no interest in letting something that had the potential to become another Calamity wander around in their world.
He moved.
"Wait!" Ezrak understood immediately and the color left his face even more.
Lian jumped over a dead vein, behind the Calamity Seed’s chamber, a huge organ could be seen.

Nearly five meters tall, a mix of white and black and its overall shape was similar to a heart, but it had several separate holes and hundreds of veins entered the walls of the egg from different parts of it.
True Sequence completed the information.
All vital messages, all regeneration commands and all growth cycles, everything passed through here.
The Birth Node.
"Found you." He quietly whispered.
"Don’t touch that!" Ezrak’s voice was so loud this time that even he froze for a moment.
"The more you tell me not to touch it, the more sure I become that I found the right place." Lian gave him a quick look.
"I’m not joking this time!"
"Neither am I."
Coldness was released from his palm.
[ Frost Dominion ]
Ice formed over the Birth Node like a new layer of skin but it did not only cover the surface, the cold went deep inside and the veins turned white one after another.
The black and golden liquid inside them froze, the huge organ tried to contract once.
It stopped halfway.
"Lian, listen!
If—" The white-eyed man ran toward Lian.
An ice wall formed in front of him and he was forced to stop.
"Damn it!"
The young Vorhelm placed his palm on the frozen surface of the node, this time he did not want to create a ten-meter palm.
Size was important for beginners but density was what mattered.
Mana gathered inside his real palm, it became more compressed but a lot of it was still wasted, he was still far behind Aldric’s version.
But for the third time, it was better.
[ Suppressing Palm ]
Boom.
The sound of the impact was small, unlike what was expected, there was no huge explosion and no wall exploded.
Even the Birth Node remained almost completely intact.
Ezrak froze for a moment and Lian also lowered his hand and looked at it for a few seconds.
But then ...
Crack.
The outer shell of the node cracked.
Crack...
Crack...
Crack...
More cracks appeared, the outer flesh still kept its shape, but everything inside had completely collapsed.
The flesh, veins and nerve paths inside it had turned into a crushed mass.
...The node had died from the inside..
"No..." The white-eyed man’s face became ugly and there was even a hint of fear in his eyes and ...the entire cave went silent.
There were no more pulses, the walls became still and the veins stopped.
The half-grown arms hanging from the ceiling remained still.
The creatures that were still moving in different parts of the womb fell to the ground at the same time.
The biological lights turned off one after another, silence covered the entire cave, as if the cave had really died.
Lian heard the real silence, he slowly breathed out, he had succeeded, at least it seemed so, but there was no notification to confirm it.
He looked around, Ezrak’s face confirmed that the womb had really died.
But the white-eyed man’s eyes were fixed directly on the egg.
Lian wanted to start talking again but suddenly something beyond both of their expectations happened.
Thump!
All the veins that should have been dead suddenly contracted, but not toward him and not to attack, instead all of them moved toward the Calamity Seed’s chamber.
The young Vorhelm narrowed his eyes and the remaining liquids throughout the womb began to move.
Blood.
Mana.
Nutrient fluids.
Stored tissues.
Even parts of the incomplete creatures that had fallen to the ground began to melt, their skin collapsed and their bones became soft.
Their bodies turned into a dark liquid and were pulled toward the chamber through the veins around them.
"This...
I didn’t design this." Ezrak took one step back and his voice was so quiet that this calmness made the sentence much more frightening.
"What is happening?" Lian looked at him, from his reaction he could understand that this man was not lying.
It seemed that his decision to kill the womb had caused a chain of unexpected events that should not have happened normally.
"The womb is dying." Ezrak did not answer for several seconds, his eyes were still on the egg.
"I already understood that part."
"No."
"It has realized that the womb is dying."
The young Vorhelm became silent and Ezrak pressed his lips together.

Two meters.
Golden and black veins under its skin lit up and suddenly one of its fingers moved ...
Very slightly but enough to make Ezrak freeze.

It was only one beat but it had appeared suddenly for no reason, as if something had managed to get its attention.

chapters.title: Chapter 472: The Unborn Saint II
paragraphs: [Emergency Quest Generated.]
[Kill the Unborn Saint before full growth.]
[Time Remaining: 59:59]
[Failure Consequence: Birth of a New Calamity that can wander in your world.]
[Do you accept the Quest?]
Lian looked at the notification, it was exactly like the Quest he had received when he faced the Ant Queen in the Special Area.
But there was one difference here, the creature was not after his body, it was after something inside his body and whatever the Ruined Heart was, the Saint could sense it.

And that was strange, during his battle with the Ant Queen, that thing had not sensed the Ruined Heart, of course, maybe it had sensed it and because he himself did not know that something like this was hidden inside him at that time, he had not noticed it.
Because he remembered that the Calamity Seed also wanted to take over his body, so maybe it had noticed the heart.
But one question came up, why could the Seeds notice the existence of the Ruined Heart, but true Calamities like the Black Silence could not identify the Ruined Heart?
Could this be the will of the Ruined Heart itself?
In any case, this was not the time to think about it, Lian first accepted the Quest and then lowered his palm.
[Frost Dominion]
Crack!
Ice rose from the ground and caught the Saint’s legs, it went up to his knees and then to his waist, and in less than two seconds, half of his body was trapped inside the ice.
He did not give it a chance to react and mana gathered in his palm, forming a palm about eight meters wide in front of him.
[Suppressing Palm]
He pushed it forward.
Boom!

The attack hit the Seed directly in the chest and the ice around its body exploded, the creature was dragged several meters across the ground and then hit the dead living wall like a piece of white flesh.
Kaboom!
Its chest sank in and its right arm broke at an unnatural angle, deep cracks appeared on its white skin.
For a moment Ezrak held his breath, maybe it was still incomplete and maybe it could still be stopped.
Then ...crack.
The broken bone moved, but it did not simply return to its place, its structure changed, the chest opened and bones grew from inside.
One.
Two.
Five.
In a few seconds, the structure of its chest turned into several connected rings and each layer could send the pressure to the next layer.
Like dense bone springs.
Notifications appeared.
[Biological threat recorded: Extreme cold.]
[Growth path changing.]
[Threat recorded: Compressed pressure.]
[Growth response forming.]
[Heat circulation structure modified.]
[Impact distribution structure created.]
Lian narrowed his eyes slightly, the remaining cold on the creature’s body started to melt and the black blood under its skin changed color.
Silver lines appeared inside it.
"No... it’s learning from you." Ezrak took a step back and ran his fingers through his messy hair.
This creature was becoming stronger by getting hurt, it was learning and adapting.
This was exactly the same feature he had put into his masterpiece in the border city, and at that time it had also caused Lian a headache.
His eyes returned to the Saint and the creature slowly stood up.
There was no anger or pain on it, it was like a transcendent creature that could not be affected by any event of mortals.
"It wasn’t supposed to grow like this. I was supposed to decide its path, member by member, tissue by tissue, change by change!" Ezrak continued in fear and pointed at the creature.
"But now it’s deciding by itself what it needs, the more you fight it, the more you complete it!"
The young Vorhelm looked at the creature for a few seconds, at the new chest and the blood that was now more resistant to the ice.
"So what’s your suggestion? Should I stand here and let it eat me? If I don’t do anything, it will eat you too, idiot." Then he asked very calmly.
"No!"
"Then be quiet."
"You really—" The white-eyed man opened his mouth but could not find any words for a few seconds.
The Unborn Saint moved again and the second branch of its halo bent toward the wall, sinking into a mass of dead tissue.
Pach!
Black and golden veins entered the remains from the bones of the halo.
The tissue around it started to dry and its materials were pulled toward the Saint’s body.
"No, it’s consuming them too." Ezrak opened his eyes wider.
Lian moved before he could finish his sentence.
[Thunder Step]
Boom!
This time the pressure from the weight was lower, he entered from the right side and lightning gathered around his right fist.
[Thunder Calamity]
At the same time, a huge icy claw also formed around the same hand.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
His fist hit the Saint’s neck directly.
Kaaaboom!
Lightning covered its entire body and the white skin burned in several places, its muscles shook and the claw managed to enter slightly into the monster’s body.
The golden veins went dark for a moment and the creature’s head turned almost ninety degrees.
But it did not fall and the third branch of its halo went into the ground behind it.
Lian jumped back and heard the sound of bones growing.
Crack... crack...
Thin bone plates came out along the Saint’s spine.
They continued down to the ground, like bars for transferring force and the creature returned its head to its normal position.
He gathered Thunder Calamity on his palm again together with the icy claw and attacked without giving that thing a chance.
Lightning entered the Saint’s body.
But this time a large part of the current passed through the bone plates and entered the ground.
Krrrrr!
The floor of the cave exploded and the Saint only took one step back, then the fingers of its left hand lit up and black-golden arcs appeared between its fingers.
The young Vorhelm raised an eyebrow, had this thing copied his skill ...? But after watching it, he realized that no.
It had not copied his skill, it did not even have the structure of Thunder Calamity, it had only stored the remaining energy inside a new organ.
And now it released it.
Boom!
A black-golden arc came out of its hand. Lian stepped onto an ice platform and threw himself upward.
The lightning passed under his feet, destroyed several side chambers and he turned in the air.
When facing such a complex creature, the best thing to do was understand how its structure worked.
[True Sequence]
The creature’s structure opened in his mind but the information did not stay the same.
[Structure is not stable.]
[Previous analysis is becoming invalid.]
[New paths are forming.]
He landed on the second platform and while the Saint looked at him, he understood the problem.
True Sequence was perfect for reading a structure but this thing did not have a stable structure.
Every attack it received made it rewrite a part of itself.
Lian was reading a book while the writer was tearing out its pages and writing them again at the same time.
"Annoying." He said under his breath and looked at Ezrak, once again he really wanted to punch that bastard in the face.
This Calamity Seed had just been born, it was Level 40 and like a baby, it knew nothing about the world around it and was slowly learning with every passing second.
But that was exactly the problem, what would it become when it was complete?
The Saint suddenly stopped and the young Vorhelm also stopped moving.
The creature stood in the center of the area, its head slightly tilted to one side, the five complete branches of its halo slowly opened behind it.
The remaining lights in the cave went out.
One.
Then another.
Until the area became almost completely dark and only the golden and black veins on the Saint’s body were glowing.
Then all the dead veins of the womb moved again, but not by their own power, something was pulling them by force.
Black-golden blood came out of the walls, stored liquids rose from the ground and dead tissues started to melt.
Everything moved toward the five branches of the halo.
"Stop it from feeding! It wants to complete its growth!" Ezrak said in fear.
Mana exploded in Lian’s legs.
[Thunder Step]
He went directly toward the Saint but the five branches of the halo immediately cast shadows on the ground.
He had only covered half the distance when the shadows gained flesh and the five black lines on the ground turned into real veins.
A thin bone pillar came out from the end of each one.
Five pillars and each one was at a different point of the area, the veins connected them and in a few seconds, a living circuit was formed.
The young Vorhelm changed his path and cut one of the lines with the edge of ice.
Pach!
But instead of stopping, two smaller veins grew from the cut.
He frowned and the ground started to pull itself together, really pulling itself together and the dead walls of the womb were being dragged toward the center.
The space of the area became smaller and the bone pillars moved.
The farther he moved back, the less safe space remained and three bone pillars attacked him from the left.
Lian created an ice platform under his feet, went upward and at the same moment another vein grew in the air in front of him.
[Ash Step]
His body disappeared and a moment later he appeared on the second platform, the Saint only looked at him from below.
And the young Vorhelm activated Thunder Step in the air, his body moved like a horizontal bolt of lightning between two pillars.
He appeared behind the Calamity Seed, his fist was covered with lightning but just before the attack, True Sequence showed him something.
Five branches and five connections, each connected to a different part of the womb and each responsible for a different type of adaptation.
One was pressure, one was heat, one was energy control, one was feeding and one was regeneration, but the sixth branch was connected to nothing.
During all this time, it had only pointed in one direction.
Lian.
More exactly, toward his chest.
At that moment the Ruined Heart beat again.
Thump!
The incomplete branch also shook and grew two centimeters!
The young Vorhelm froze in the air for a fraction of a second and a notification appeared.
[Anomaly detected.]
[The Calamity Seed is trying to complete the sixth structure.]
[Target source: Unknown.]
Lian’s eyes narrowed, so the matter was not only about eating him, this creature’s body thought that something inside him was the missing part of its growth.
Unfortunately, the System notifications did not give a more complete explanation about what exactly this sixth structure was and what it was supposed to do.
But whatever it was, because it needed something like the Ruined Heart to complete itself, he could not allow it to become complete.
At the same time, the Saint moved and this time its attack pattern had completely changed.
Its hand was no longer going toward Lian’s head or stomach, all its movements were aimed at the center of his chest.
It took one step and the pressure of its weight fell on Lian again but this time he was ready.
[Ash Step]
White fingers passed through his gray body and he appeared three meters to the left.
[Thunder Step]
Boom!

He entered from the side and his fist was covered with Thunder Calamity and a huge icy claw, the Saint did not even turn its head toward him and the young Vorhelm slammed his fist directly into its mouthless face.
Kaboom!
The Saint’s head violently turned to one side, part of its face cracked.
But it had not defended itself, it had intentionally taken the attack and at that moment the Predator’s Instincts screamed and Lian lowered his eyes.
Too late!
One of the white strands behind the Saint had come directly toward his chest like a spear ...

Until the area became almost completely dark and only the golden and black veins on the Saint’s body were glowing.
Then all the dead veins of the womb moved again, but not by their own power, something was pulling them by force.
Black-golden blood came out of the walls, stored liquids rose from the ground and dead tissues started to melt.
Everything moved toward the five branches of the halo.
"Stop it from feeding!
It wants to complete its growth!" Ezrak said in fear.
Mana exploded in Lian’s legs.
[Thunder Step]
He went directly toward the Saint but the five branches of the halo immediately cast shadows on the ground.
He had only covered half the distance when the shadows gained flesh and the five black lines on the ground turned into real veins.
A thin bone pillar came out from the end of each one.
Five pillars and each one was at a different point of the area, the veins connected them and in a few seconds, a living circuit was formed.
The young Vorhelm changed his path and cut one of the lines with the edge of ice.
Pach!
But instead of stopping, two smaller veins grew from the cut.
He frowned and the ground started to pull itself together, really pulling itself together and the dead walls of the womb were being dragged toward the center.
The space of the area became smaller and the bone pillars moved.
The farther he moved back, the less safe space remained and three bone pillars attacked him from the left.
Lian created an ice platform under his feet, went upward and at the same moment another vein grew in the air in front of him.
[Ash Step]
His body disappeared and a moment later he appeared on the second platform, the Saint only looked at him from below.
And the young Vorhelm activated Thunder Step in the air, his body moved like a horizontal bolt of lightning between two pillars.
He appeared behind the Calamity Seed, his fist was covered with lightning but just before the attack, True Sequence showed him something.
Five branches and five connections, each connected to a different part of the womb and each responsible for a different type of adaptation.
One was pressure, one was heat, one was energy control, one was feeding and one was regeneration, but the sixth branch was connected to nothing.
During all this time, it had only pointed in one direction.
Lian.
More exactly, toward his chest.
At that moment the Ruined Heart beat again.
Thump!
The incomplete branch also shook and grew two centimeters!
The young Vorhelm froze in the air for a fraction of a second and a notification appeared.
[Anomaly detected.]
[The Calamity Seed is trying to complete the sixth structure.]
[Target source: Unknown.]
Lian’s eyes narrowed, so the matter was not only about eating him, this creature’s body thought that something inside him was the missing part of its growth.
Unfortunately, the System notifications did not give a more complete explanation about what exactly this sixth structure was and what it was supposed to do.
But whatever it was, because it needed something like the Ruined Heart to complete itself, he could not allow it to become complete.
At the same time, the Saint moved and this time its attack pattern had completely changed.
Its hand was no longer going toward Lian’s head or stomach, all its movements were aimed at the center of his chest.
It took one step and the pressure of its weight fell on Lian again but this time he was ready.
[Ash Step]
White fingers passed through his gray body and he appeared three meters to the left.
[Thunder Step]
Boom!

He entered from the side and his fist was covered with Thunder Calamity and a huge icy claw, the Saint did not even turn its head toward him and the young Vorhelm slammed his fist directly into its mouthless face.
Kaboom!
The Saint’s head violently turned to one side, part of its face cracked.
But it had not defended itself, it had intentionally taken the attack and at that moment the Predator’s Instincts screamed and Lian lowered his eyes.
Too late!
One of the white strands behind the Saint had come directly toward his chest like a spear ...

chapters.title: Chapter 473: The Unborn Saint IV
paragraphs: One of the white strands behind the Unborn Saint was coming directly toward the center of Lian’s chest like a thin spear.
Predator’s Instincts were no longer warning him.
They were screaming, and the distance was so short that even Ash Step could no longer move his body completely out of the way in time.
Without a moment of hesitation, he opened his storage space, and a black mass appeared in front of his body.
In a fraction of a second, heavy, dark plates locked onto his legs, chest, shoulders, and arms.
Thin silver gaps between the plates lit up, and finally, the black face cover came down over his face.
[World-Devourer Bastion activated.]
[Mountain Frame is active.]
[Giant’s Momentum is active.]
The strand reached him.
KAAAAANG!
A sound like two huge pieces of metal hitting each other spread through the cave, and the chest plate of the armor bent inward.
His body left the ground and was thrown more than thirty meters backward like a black bullet.
BOOOOM!
His back hit the dead wall of the womb, and dried flesh, bone, and ice exploded at the same time, causing the entire section behind him to collapse.
For several seconds, nothing could be seen except ice dust and pieces of tissue in the air.
If the World-Devourer Bastion had not been on his body, that strand would probably have pierced through his chest and come out from his back.
Even now, heavy pain spread from the center of his chest to his spine, and the quiet sound of stone breaking came from inside the dust.
Lian pushed away a large piece of dead tissue and came out of the hole, a deep crack had appeared in the middle of the armor’s chest plate.
A thin line of blood also ran down from the corner of his mouth, he wiped his mouth with the back of his hand and looked at the blood.
Then he looked at the crack in the armor and finally at the white-eyed man.
"To hell with you and your stupid ideas, did you really have to make something like this? Bastard, couldn’t you just rot in prison?"
Ezrak stared at him from several dozen meters away.
"This is not the time to joke!"
Lian turned his eyes back to the Saint and the creature was standing still.
That huge black eye behind the opening on its face was fixed on him without blinking, the sixth branch of the bone halo was still incomplete.
But after the contact a few moments ago, it had clearly become a little longer.
The young Vorhelm slowly closed his fists, there was not much time left until the end of the Quest and there was definitely a reason why the system had only given him one hour.
It was possible that this was the amount of time the Calamity Seed needed to complete its growth.
[Warrior’s Madness]
It had been a while since he had used it, of course because it could cause mental corruption and madness, but now he was facing an opponent against whom hiding his power had no meaning.
[Mental Corruption: 1%]
Mana exploded throughout his body and blue-purple lightning moved like wild snakes over the dark plates of the World-Devourer Bastion.
[Thunder Calamity]
His right hand opened and ice grew around his fingers and forearm at a terrifying speed, turning into a huge curved claw.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
And then he disappeared.
Thunder Step.
Boom!
The place where he had been standing sank, and his body appeared on the right side of the Saint, the ice claw together with his lightning-covered fist struck the creature’s side.
KAAAAABOOOM!
The white skin cracked and lightning entered the tissue, the ice claw pierced several centimeters into its body and tore apart a large part of the Saint’s side.
The six-meter body bent, but Lian did not give it even one second and his left foot landed hard on the ground.
[Iron Fortress Charge]
At the same time, Giant’s Momentum.
The real mass of the armor, the power of the movement, and the acceleration of his entire body gathered into his right shoulder.
He slammed directly into the Saint’s chest.
BOOOOOOM!
The air exploded and the Saint left the ground and flew backward like a white projectile.
Ten meters.
Twenty meters.
Thirty meters.
Its body hit the wall of the cave and sank several meters into the flesh and stone.
Ezrak’s mouth was slightly open, but Vorhelm had still not finished.
[Thunder Step]
He appeared in front of the creature again and his right hand was placed directly on the Saint’s sunken chest.
[Cataclysm Pulse]
BOOOOOOOOOOM!

The explosion happened at zero distance and the Saint’s chest tissue was destroyed from the inside, its bones broke and black and golden liquid splashed onto the wall and a large part of its chest was practically empty.
For several moments, Lian was really crushing the creature.
Ezrak had even forgotten to blink.
"You..." The white-eyed man was now also looking at him with fear, as if he had not expected this level of power from him.
The last time they had seen each other, this boy was not even close to this level of power and now he was pushing back the Calamity Seed that he himself had created!
Could he be seeing things wrong... or was Lian the real Calamity Seed?
The young Vorhelm did not look at him and even ignored him, the Saint was still inside the wall.
But then one of the branches of the halo bent backward and sank into the corpse of the womb, and the dead tissue started to dry.
Blood and biological materials were pulled toward the creature’s body like a thin river.
The destroyed chest started to grow again, but not like before and the bones were not simply repairing themselves, their structure was changing.
Multi-layered rings, denser muscles, and veins whose paths were different from a few seconds ago.
Lian frowned and the creature came out of the wall, its head was slightly bent but its black eye was still looking only at him.
More womb tissue entered its body.
[New growth stage recorded.]
The pressure of its presence changed and the young Vorhelm activated Thunder Step at the same moment, this time he wanted to reach it before its regeneration was complete.
His body turned into lightning, but the Saint’s eye moved and for the first time it managed to follow the movement of Thunder Step.
Its white hand came up.
Lian’s palm, covered in lightning and the ice claw, went directly into the creature’s hand.
Boom!
The impact shook the entire cave and he expected the Saint’s hand to move backward.
It did not.
His attack was neither pushed away nor blocked, it was simply stopped and his eyes narrowed slightly, and the Calamity Seed raised its other hand..
Its palm hit the side of the armor.
KAAAAABOOOM!
For a moment, all the air left Lian’s lungs and his body was thrown across the ground and dragged dozens of meters over the dead tissue.
Two side plates of the armor cracked.
Mountain Frame spread a large part of the force across the entire armor, but even that amount was enough for a sharp pain to pass through his ribs.
He quickly stood on one knee and breathed.
He felt terrible pain and even the armor failed to fully spread it out and his left rib might have cracked.
At that moment, because of the damage he had taken, he felt more power flowing through his body as if all his stats had been boosted.
This was the effect of Warrior’s Madness.
[Mental Corruption: 23%]
But apart from the increase in power, his mental corruption had also suddenly increased by a lot.
At the same moment, the Saint took a step and Lian immediately pulled a small bottle out of his storage space.
He opened the cap with his teeth and drank the liquid in one breath, and warmth spread through his chest.
The small internal bleeding decreased and the pain in his rib became a little calmer.
Then he stood up, but this time he did not attack the Saint directly.
Level forty was one thing.
Level forty-five was another thing.
Just these few seconds had been enough for him to understand the difference, if he entered another stupid close-range fight, this time the armor would only delay his death by a few seconds.
And now he understood that this was not even the limit of this creature and why there was a (65) beside its Level 40, that was probably the level it would reach after completing its growth.
So instead of looking at the Saint, he looked around.
The dead womb.
Hundreds of tons of tissue.
Incomplete cores.
Laboratory creatures.
Nutrients.
Everything the Calamity Seed needed to grow was right under its feet and every second the branches of the halo were absorbing more of it.
The young Vorhelm narrowed his eyes, killing this creature with direct attacks was teaching it, damaging it was forcing its body to evolve.
And the more they fought, the more materials it absorbed for regeneration.
So the problem was no longer how to hurt the Saint more.
He had to take away its food so it could no longer grow.

chapters.title: Chapter 474: The Unborn Saint V ( GT Bonus - )
paragraphs: Lian’s eyes moved over the womb, and then something came to his mind.
A very small smile appeared under his face cover.
"I have an idea."
He opened his storage space, and a large object came out of the darkness.
Devouring Egg.
The strange shell of the egg stayed still under the weak light of the cave for a few seconds.
"What is that now?" Ezrak stared at it.
The young Vorhelm placed the egg on a huge mass of dead tissue.
"Don’t you feel hungry? It’s time to eat a cave."
Nothing happened for a few seconds, and then... suddenly, the shell shook and thin lines appeared on its surface.
[Huge food source detected.]
[Biomass suitable for growth detected.]
[Feeding process started.]
Pach!
Several dark strands came out from the bottom of the egg and entered the flesh of the womb, the tissue around them immediately started to dry.
Biological materials were pulled toward the egg.
One meter.
Two meters.
Five meters.
The eating process became faster with every second, and on the other side, the branches of the Saint’s halo were also eating the same corpse.
One huge corpse.
Two creatures, and now both of them were consuming it from two different sides.
Ezrak only looked at the scene for several seconds, his face had an expression that even Lian could not tell whether it was anger or confusion.
"You... brought an unknown creature into my unknown creature’s womb so it could steal its corpse from my unknown child?"
"When you say it like that, the plan sounds even better." Lian gave him a short look.
"That was not a compliment!"
"Anyway, if you don’t want to die, stay quiet, don’t forget that your dear child wants to kill you and for now, I am the one standing in its way." Of course, Vorhelm said it mostly in a mocking tone.
This white-eyed bastard could use that bell to leave this place whenever he wanted, at least that was his guess.
But it was interesting that he was still here, maybe he wanted to see the result?
Ezrak’s mouth stayed open for a moment, and he could not find an answer, in fact, he realized that his survival currently depended on this boy.
Unfortunately, he could not run away, otherwise he would have already done it.
But the Saint reacted differently, its black eye moved away from Lian for the first time and fixed itself on the Devouring Egg.
One of the halo’s branches came out of the womb’s corpse, the long bone bent like a spear and moved directly toward the egg.
"I’m not allowing that." Lian moved at the same moment.
[Thunder Step.]
Boom!
He appeared between the Calamity Seed and the egg, at the same moment the branch came down and he placed both feet firmly on the ground.
[Mountain Anchor]
The armor plates on his legs locked onto the surface, the force from his legs entered the ground and he raised both arms.
KAAAAANG!
The bone branch came down on his armored forearms and the ground under his feet sank several meters around him.
His knees bent and new cracks spread across the forearms of the World-Devourer Bastion, blood ran down from his nose.
But he did not move back even one step, and the egg behind him continued eating the womb.
And because of the damage he received, the flow of power in his body increased even more.
[Mental Corruption: 31%]
The Saint raised the branch and this time its entire body came forward, Lian prepared for the second attack, but before the attack landed, another part of the womb was absorbed by the halo.
[New growth stage recorded.]
The young Vorhelm’s expression changed.
Bad.
Very bad!
The branch came down again and Mountain Anchor was still active, he expected to be pushed back, this attack was from a Level 50 creature!.
He was wrong, it was not simply a matter of being pushed back...
BOOOOOOM!
The ground under his feet exploded and Mountain Anchor transferred the force into the ground for a fraction of a second, then the ground itself could no longer تحمل it.
The entire icy and tissue-covered floor under his feet broke.
Lian was separated from the ground and his body went into one of the icy tunnels like a stone thrown by a catapult.
Boom!
The first wall broke.
Boom!
The second.
BOOOOM!
The third.
More than one hundred meters away, he finally stopped inside a mass of ice, he did not move for several seconds and then the fingers of his right hand moved.
Pieces of ice moved aside and he sat up, took a deep breath and pain stabbed into his chest like a knife.
"H..." One of his ribs was not just cracked this time, it was probably broken, and his left hand also shook slightly for several seconds.
The flow of power in his body increased again because of the damage, but it was useless, he was facing an opponent whose power difference was too great, so great that no boost could make up for it.
[Mental Corruption: 47%]
Even so, he did not turn off the skill, the fact that he had still been able to survive this long was thanks to the boosts from Warrior’s Madness.
Lian took out the second bottle and drank it, warmth spread through his body again and the damaged rib was not completely healed, but at least the broken parts were stabilized.
Then he stood up and looked at the Level notification again.
"Level fifty... okay."
"Then I really can’t let you hit me anymore." From now on he could only dodge, if he was hit, staying alive would not be easy.
The sound of ice breaking came from the tunnel... the Saint was getting closer.
The young Vorhelm looked behind him, the exit of the cave could be seen.
The womb still had a lot of food for it, even with the Devouring Egg, the Saint could feed from another part.
So he had to separate that thing from its food, but what did the Saint want more than the womb’s food?
He placed his hand on the center of his chest for a moment, the Ruined Heart was still and unmoving, but the Calamity Seed wanted it.
Lian gave a calm smile, if a hunter wanted its prey, all he needed to do was make the prey go somewhere else.
A few seconds later, the Saint entered the tunnel and its black eye immediately fixed on him and instead of attacking, he turned around and started running.
[Thunder Step]
Boom!
"Where are you going?!" Ezrak, who had reached them from another part, shouted.
"Outside." The time for a strategic retreat had come.
Lian created an ice platform under his feet and crossed a huge gap.
The white-eyed man, seeing that his child was coming after them, no longer had time to ask for the reason and started running with him.
Behind them... BOOOOOOM!
The Saint did not even use the tunnel anymore and directly broke through the wall, a huge amount of ice and stone scattered around.
The six-meter body passed through it and one branch of the halo entered the wall, suddenly, gravitational pressure appeared behind the young Vorhelm.
His body was pulled backward for a moment, but he grabbed the ceiling with his hand.
[Suppressing Palm]
This time the target was not the Saint.
Boom!
The ceiling several dozen meters ahead of the creature collapsed and hundreds of tons of ice and stone fell onto the path.
The creature disappeared under the rubble, it was not supposed to be hurt, but at least it could buy some time.
Lian did not even look back.
Three seconds.
That was all he wanted.
Three seconds of time.
[Ash Step]
He passed through a narrow section where the dead womb was collapsing.
[Thunder Step]
The distance became larger, but suddenly there was an explosion behind him and the Saint came out from the rubble.
But the three seconds had been spent and enough distance had been created.
Lian passed beside the main section of the laboratory, the Devouring Egg was still eating and huge masses of tissue were drying one after another.
Parts of the cave were collapsing because the biological structure was being destroyed.
"My laboratory!" Ezrak almost shouted when he saw the scene.
"Do you prefer your life or this cave?"
"Both!"
"If you don’t sacrifice something, you’ll lose both."
"I really hate you!"
Lian did not answer, the mouth of the cave could be seen ahead, the white land of Antarctica could be seen from there.
He activated the last Thunder Step he needed inside the cave, his body jumped out of the entrance and the icy wind immediately hit his armor.
As far as the eye could see, there was only white, huge amounts of snow, ice, and mountains that disappeared in the distance under the gray sky.
He landed on the ice and two seconds later... BOOOOOOOOM!
Part of the mountain behind him exploded, pieces of ice as large as houses flew through the air and the Unborn Saint came directly out of the wall.
Its entire body could be seen under the cold light of Antarctica and the bone halo behind its head was open like a twisted crown.
Golden-black veins shone under its white skin and the strands behind its body moved in the wind like incomplete wings.
Ezrak also came out of the entrance a few moments later, he looked inside the cave and then at the Devouring Egg that was still there.
His face twisted, but he had no time to complain.
The Saint released the stored materials inside its body and the golden veins became brighter.
New pressure appeared in the area and this time even the snowy wind coming toward the Saint was pushed away before reaching its body.
Lian slowly breathed out, the battle was not over, it had only changed its form, and now he had to face a Level 55 bastard.
The Saint disappeared.
Predator’s Instincts suddenly screamed.
Left, the attack was coming from the left!
The young Vorhelm activated Ash Step without looking and those long white fingers passed directly through the place where his head had been a moment ago.
He appeared behind the Saint.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
Crack!
The claw hit the back of the creature’s knee, the tissue and tendon of part of the joint were cut.
[Cataclysm Pulse]
Boom!
The explosive wave did not even push the Saint back and it did not seem to feel anything from any of these attacks.
The young Vorhelm moved back at the same moment, just as he had thought, attacking was useless, this thing could no longer even feel his attacks.
The Saint turned around and its gaze fell on him again, on the thing it needed to complete itself.
