The giant ant attacked at that moment, and his huge body moved forward with a speed greater than what could be expected from his size.
His heavy front leg landed directly on the lizard’s back.
Boom!
The stone floor cracked, but the monster did not die, the plates on its back spread the force, and the lizard turned with a rough sound and hit One’s side with its heavy tail.
Crack!
One moved half a step.
Lian did not interfere.
The lizard gathered its body behind its stone plates again, and One raised his claw once more, but this time he stopped.
His antennae moved, and instead of attacking directly, he attacked from the side, one of his front legs went under the lizard’s body.
He lifted its body, and the monster struggled as the giant ant turned it with more force.
Boom!
The lizard fell on its back, its soft and unarmored stomach was exposed and One’s jaws came down.
Crack!
The entire soft part of its stomach was torn open, and a few seconds later the monster became still.
[Special Colony Member, One, received Exp.]
"Great." Lian nodded, and One sent a clear feeling of pride through the link.
But their work had only just started, and they continued along their path based on the World Memory.
The second hunt was a little harder.
The Broken-Tusk Boar appeared in a small field almost an hour later, its height was close to 3 meters.
Two broken and curved bone tusks came out from both sides of its jaw, and the muscles on its shoulders were so large that the front half of its body looked unnaturally heavy.
[Broken-Tusk Boar.]
[Level: 18.]
As soon as the boar saw them, it dug the ground with its foot and then attacked.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
Every step sent dirt into the air, One did not run this time and his six legs firmly stood on the ground.
His head lowered and the collision happened ...BOOOOM!
A wave of dirt spread around them, and the giant ant was pushed almost two meters back while the other monster was thrown one meter back.
Both of them stood again.
The boar attacked for the second time without stopping, and this time One did not repeat the same mistake, just one moment before the collision, he moved the weight of his body to the right.
One of his front legs hit the boar’s shoulder, changing the direction of its attack, and the boar passed beside One.
Before it could turn its heavy body back, the giant ant fell on it.
Two front legs held the boar’s legs against the ground, and the giant jaws closed.
Crack!
Its neck broke.
Lian watched from a few meters away, One was no longer just a creature that crushed everything with raw power.
He was slowly learning, and what he learned remained in his mind, which was normal, this ant had very good intelligence.
Several more hunts continued.
Two level sixteen lizards and a group of carrion crows that kept attacking from above.
In that fight, One was bothered more than ever, the monsters came down each time, attacked, and then went back up.
He could not easily reach them.
Lian only created a few ice blades in the air, but not to kill them, only to block their escape paths, and this forced one of the crows to fly lower.
One was waiting for it, and with a heavy jump, his jaws closed around the monster’s wing and slammed it directly onto the ground.
The others were also caught one after another, and after the last crow, a faint light came out of One’s body and the giant creature stopped for a moment.
The young Vorhelm opened his panel.

[Maximum level before the first evolution has been reached.]
[Level condition completed.]
[Checking evolution conditions...]
He waited for a few seconds, and then a new notification appeared.

[To begin evolution, the special member must absorb more monster cores.]
[Required amount: Variable.]
[The quality, level, rank, and compatibility of the core affect the amount of absorption.]
[Final condition: Reach complete saturation.]
Monsters had to eat the cores of other monsters to evolve, at least this was true for Normal monsters and, to some extent, Mutated monsters.
Of course, absorbing the cores of other monsters was one of their two paths, and it was considered the harder path for monsters.

And if those humans were Awakened, even better.
For Fallen Monsters and especially higher ones such as Unholy, who had intelligence at the level of humans, their evolution conditions could be much more complicated.
In any case, the condition for One was clear too, he had to absorb the cores of other monsters, and there was no specific number.

He mostly seemed eager, as if he could not wait to have his first evolution.

chapters.title: Chapter 482: The Wolfgrave Fortresses
paragraphs: [Total stats points: 1079]
Just a few minutes ago, he only had 150 stats points, and now after killing 5 wolves, his total had reached more than 1000 stats points.
And with the ten Fragments he had obtained, it had been an extremely successful hunt.
He now understood how much his first evolution had changed his innate skills, at this rate, perhaps it would not even take long before he reached his stats limit again.
But that was not a bad thing, the sooner he could become stronger, the easier it would be for him to deal with any problem that appeared in front of him.
In any case, the Wolfgrave Frontier was not only a good place to increase his level, if he could hunt a large number of wolf-type monsters there, he could also obtain hundreds of Fragments.
"Try it." He then pointed at One and told him to come and absorb the cores of these monsters.
One came toward them with his jaws open, found the cores, and absorbed them without wasting any time.
[Monster cores absorbed.]
[First evolution condition is progressing.]
[Saturation: Insufficient.]
Lian expected this, so he wanted to ride him again and continue their path, but just as One was coming toward him, suddenly ...the Predator’s Instincts gave a warning!
New presences were approaching them, six monsters in total, but the strange thing was their speed.
They were coming slowly, not as if they were trying to surround or attack them.
Lian raised his hand and the giant ant stopped there, the fog between the trees moved and the first wolf came out.
Its appearance was different from the previous ones, its body was thinner but taller and its fur was almost black, parts of its shoulders and neck were covered with gray bone plates.
Its eyes had a dead blue color.
[Gravehowl Wolf.]
[Rank: Normal.]
[Level: 28.]
There were five more behind it.
[Level: 27.]
[Level: 29.]
[Level: 28.]
[Level: 29.]
One took an attacking position, but the wolves did not look at him and went directly toward the corpses.

The young Vorhelm raised an eyebrow and one of the Gravehowls grabbed the neck of a dead wolf between its jaws, another pulled the legs of another corpse, and two of them lifted a larger corpse together.
None of them started eating, they did not even look hungry, instead they were collecting the corpses.
One took a step forward as if he wanted to interfere, but Lian sent an order to stop through the link.
"Wait."
Dissatisfaction came from One, but his master’s answer did not change.
"Let them take them."
The giant ant turned his head toward him this time, why should they let these monsters leave instead of killing them?
But Lian said nothing else, although his question was clear.
Why?
Why would a group of monsters collect corpses? If they were going to eat them, they would eat them right there, but they seemed to have a specific destination.
He had never heard of monsters coming to collect the corpses of monsters of their own kind.
Well, except for what happened in the fallen border city, at that time, the monsters that Ezrak had created were also collecting the corpses of their own kind.
But that situation was different, they were doing it because Ezrak had ordered them to.
So why were these monsters doing it?
Lian fixed his eyes on one of the wolves.
[True Sequence.]
For a few seconds, the mana channels and different energy paths inside the monster’s body became visible to him.
Everything looked normal, both the mana channels and the other systems of its body seemed healthy.
But something was wrong behind its neck, and he narrowed his eyes.
Between the two upper vertebrae of its spine, there was a small piece of black bone, it did not seem to be a natural part of its body.
Instead, it looked like something that had been grown or implanted inside it.
Every few seconds, a very weak pulse came out of it.
A command?
A connection?
Tracking?
Lian still did not know, but he knew one thing, they had not decided to do this naturally or by instinct.
The Gravehowls collected the corpses and then moved toward the northwest.
The young Vorhelm let them get farther away, and when they were almost gone into the fog, he took out the map.
There was no clear path in the direction they were moving on the base’s version of the map, but the version combined with the World Memory showed something else.
An old and narrow road which, according to the information from the World Memory, was called [Wolfcrown Road.]
"Interesting."
The Awakened had still not completely recorded this path.
And at that exact moment, something inside his storage space moved, he took out the Celestial Book of Treasure, and the golden cover of the book was already glowing before it even opened.
The pages turned quickly, the purple mark appeared again, and this time its light was several times stronger.
He held the map in front of him, and the thread from the book moved along Wolfcrown Road.
Exactly in the same direction that the Gravehowls were moving.
[Treasure detected.]
[Approximate direction: Northwest.]

Lian only looked for a few seconds, naturally, it was clear that he was going to follow those wolves, he did not know where they were going, but he was sure that there was some kind of side path that went deeper into the Wolfgrave area.
He closed the book.
And he and One moved.
They kept a large distance from the Gravehowls, the pack was not in much of a hurry either, the corpses had slowed their movement.
The old road slowly appeared from under the dirt.
Large, smooth stones that had been placed next to each other hundreds of years ago could still be recognized under the layers of moss and dirt.
The path went through a dead forest, and a little farther ahead, the first real sign of the old civilization appeared.
A village.
Or what was left of it, dozens of stone houses with collapsed roofs stood on both sides of the road.
The windows were empty, the doors were broken, and some walls were completely covered under black vines.
It was clear that this had once been a village where people had lived, but after the Calamity spread, everything had been destroyed.
The Gravehowls passed through the village without stopping, and Lian and One entered a few minutes later.
In the middle of the small village square, there was a large statue, the upper part of the statue was broken.
But its shape could still be recognized, it looked like the statue of one of the gods, one of the seven gods whose traces could also be found in the nine Ruined Realms.
Lian stood in front of the statue for a few seconds.

The statue was made of dark stone and was almost seven meters tall, it had a tall and thin body and a messy robe covered it, the folds of the robe twisted in different directions, as if even the stone did not follow any clear order.
Eight arms came out from the body of the statue, some were open, some were bent, and some held something broken.
There were also eight eyes on its face, each looking in a different direction.
But the face was almost destroyed.
Hundreds of deep lines had been carved across the stone and had destroyed the nose and lips, while the strangest thing was that all eight eyes were almost completely intact.
Lian slightly frowned.
This was not the first time he had seen a sign of one of the seven Divines.
Before this, he had found the Divine of Light’s ruins, the same place where Kain had been trapped.
His eyes moved again over the eight arms, eight eyes, and the irregular robe.
"Divine of Chaos..." Lian quietly whispered.
At the foot of the statue, part of an old inscription still remained.
[...Order is the prison of those who see only one answer...]
[...Chaos is the beginning of all possibilities...]
Lian looked at the ruins around him.
The same spiral symbol could also be seen on the walls of several houses and on the stones of the square.
So this was probably not just a normal village.
The people of this place had once been followers of the Divine of Chaos.
One stood beside the statue and Lian opened the map again, the road passed through the village and then reached the part where the information was incomplete.
A place where the World Memory no longer had complete data, but the Celestial Book of Treasure was still showing the path.
They continued, and about half an hour later, when they were completely far from the village and there was no longer any sign of it, the Gravehowls suddenly stopped.
He also stopped at a distance, and the wind passed between the dead trees for a few seconds.
Then...Awooooooooooooooo—
A howl came from far away, and the sound was so powerful that even the air around them seemed to shake, the carrion birds flew into the air from the tops of the trees.
One immediately lowered his body, and the young Vorhelm also raised his eyes in the direction of the sound.
A few seconds later, a second howl answered from somewhere else.
Then a third.
And a fourth.
Within a few moments, dozens of howls rose from different parts of the forest.
Different packs were answering each other, and even the Gravehowls in front of Lian raised their heads and howled at the same time.
System notifications appeared.
[Hidden Area discovered.]
[Wolfgrave Fortresses.]
He took his eyes off the notification, and at that exact moment, he saw something behind the fog.
At a very far distance, at first only a dark shadow could be seen, and then as the fog moved, towers appeared, broken towers and huge walls whose height could be seen even from this distance.
A half-collapsed central tower stood higher than the others, and on the highest part of the fortress, there was a giant statue of a wolf.
And a crown was placed on its skull.
The Celestial Book of Treasure suddenly opened by itself, and a page between Lian’s hands began to glow, the purple mark was beating strongly.
[Treasure detected.]

The statue was made of dark stone and was almost seven meters tall, it had a tall and thin body and a messy robe covered it, the folds of the robe twisted in different directions, as if even the stone did not follow any clear order.
Eight arms came out from the body of the statue, some were open, some were bent, and some held something broken.
There were also eight eyes on its face, each looking in a different direction.
But the face was almost destroyed.
Hundreds of deep lines had been carved across the stone and had destroyed the nose and lips, while the strangest thing was that all eight eyes were almost completely intact.
Lian slightly frowned.
This was not the first time he had seen a sign of one of the seven Divines.
Before this, he had found the Divine of Light’s ruins, the same place where Kain had been trapped.
His eyes moved again over the eight arms, eight eyes, and the irregular robe.
"Divine of Chaos..." Lian quietly whispered.
At the foot of the statue, part of an old inscription still remained.
[...Order is the prison of those who see only one answer...]
[...Chaos is the beginning of all possibilities...]
Lian looked at the ruins around him.
The same spiral symbol could also be seen on the walls of several houses and on the stones of the square.
So this was probably not just a normal village.
The people of this place had once been followers of the Divine of Chaos.
One stood beside the statue and Lian opened the map again, the road passed through the village and then reached the part where the information was incomplete.
A place where the World Memory no longer had complete data, but the Celestial Book of Treasure was still showing the path.
They continued, and about half an hour later, when they were completely far from the village and there was no longer any sign of it, the Gravehowls suddenly stopped.
He also stopped at a distance, and the wind passed between the dead trees for a few seconds.
Then...Awooooooooooooooo—
A howl came from far away, and the sound was so powerful that even the air around them seemed to shake, the carrion birds flew into the air from the tops of the trees.
One immediately lowered his body, and the young Vorhelm also raised his eyes in the direction of the sound.
A few seconds later, a second howl answered from somewhere else.
Then a third.
And a fourth.
Within a few moments, dozens of howls rose from different parts of the forest.
Different packs were answering each other, and even the Gravehowls in front of Lian raised their heads and howled at the same time.
System notifications appeared.
[Hidden Area discovered.]
[Wolfgrave Fortresses.]
He took his eyes off the notification, and at that exact moment, he saw something behind the fog.
At a very far distance, at first only a dark shadow could be seen, and then as the fog moved, towers appeared, broken towers and huge walls whose height could be seen even from this distance.
A half-collapsed central tower stood higher than the others, and on the highest part of the fortress, there was a giant statue of a wolf.
And a crown was placed on its skull.
The Celestial Book of Treasure suddenly opened by itself, and a page between Lian’s hands began to glow, the purple mark was beating strongly.
[Treasure detected.]

chapters.title: Chapter 483: The Divine Of Chaos
paragraphs: [Treasure Detected.]
The purple light between the pages of the Celestial Book of Treasure pulsed several times in a row.
Lian took his eyes off the book and looked again at what could be seen behind the thick layers of fog.
Broken towers, huge walls, and the shadow of a fortress that stood higher than all the buildings around it, several kilometers away.
But what caught his attention the most was the structure on top of the highest tower of the central fortress.
A crown.
Even from this distance, it was far too large to be considered a normal decoration.
He held the book in front of the map that he had completed with the World Memory.
A strand came out of the page.
At first, it moved along the lines of the Wolfgrave Frontier, then passed through several old structures and finally stopped directly on the central fortress.
The light moved up the tower and locked onto the same crown.
[Main Treasure Detected.]
[Location: Central Area of the Wolfgrave Fortresses.]
Lian looked at the notification without moving for a few seconds, so the treasure was not inside a hidden chest in some underground room.
The crown itself was the treasure and this treasure was completely in the open.
"It’s getting more interesting." He quietly muttered, the fact that something the Celestial Book of Treasure valued so much was this visible was not normal.
Such treasures were usually hidden or protected, and of course, this one also seemed to be protected.
Now he had to see what this treasure was.
One was standing beside him and its antennae were slowly moving in the foggy air.
He closed the book, but before he could put it inside his storage space, another notification appeared.
[Hidden Area Discovered.]
[Wolfgrave Fortresses.]
Lian raised an eyebrow, he already knew about the Wolfgrave Frontier.
That name was used for the entire large area that was made of dead forests, abandoned plains, old roads, ruined villages and the territory of several wolf packs.

The humans of Base #9 also had a lot of information about its outer parts and it was one of the relatively famous hunting areas, although its inner layers were still known for their great danger and lack of information.
But the outer layers were the opposite and that was actually his first target as well.
But it seemed fate had another plan for him and now he had found a Hidden Area, this was also the second Hidden Area he had ever managed to find.
And this place seemed different.
This place was considered a separate area inside the Wolfgrave Frontier, a huge group of fortresses, watchtowers, old walls and military roads that had once been connected to each other.
Something like a special area hidden inside a larger area.
And apparently, no Awakened had officially discovered it until now, and the System confirmed this as well.
[First Discovery Registered.]
[You are the first Awakened to discover the Wolfgrave Fortresses as a Hidden Area.]
[First Discovery Reward is being calculated.]
A few seconds later, a faint blue light appeared around Lian’s body.
[You gained one Level.]
[20 Fragments received.]
[Hidden Condition completed.]
[The title "Explorer of the Lost City" has met the conditions for Evolution.]
[Would you like to Evolve the title?]
At the bottom of the panel, another section appeared in a different color.
[Warning.]
[Title Evolution cannot be reversed.]
[The current effects of the title may be strengthened, removed or changed.]
[There is no guarantee that all abilities of the title will become better after Evolution.]
The young Vorhelm narrowed his eyes slightly.
For skills, there were many ways to replace them or even fuse them.
But titles were different.
A title was usually created by doing something special or reaching a special condition and it was not easy to find another one of the same type.
In addition, evolving them was also very rare and the requirements were very difficult and rare, not to mention that these requirements were also completely unknown.
However, the Explorer of the Lost City title had been related to discovery and exploration from the beginning, he had obtained it after discovering that Frost City together with Seris.
He thought for a few more seconds.
"Accept." He then said.
The light of the panel became stronger for a moment.
[Title Evolution has started.]
[The title "Explorer of the Lost City" has been removed.]
[New title created.]
[Pioneer of Forgotten Domains.]
[Main Effect: When discovering or entering Hidden Areas, the title can create Regional Traits based on the history, structure, creatures and laws of that area.]
[The number and power of the traits are not fixed.]
[Area Traits will become inactive after leaving the area.]
Lian raised an eyebrow slightly, if he understood correctly, every Hidden Area he found in the future could create a different effect on the title.
Almost immediately, the panel changed again.
[Wolfgrave Fortresses are being analyzed...]
[Area Trait created.]
[The title Wolf Slayer will have 300% efficiency in Wolfgrave Fortresses.]
[Fragment reward from killing wolf-based creatures ×3.]
The young Vorhelm smiled, this was a very good surprise.

The five wolves he had killed earlier had each given him two Fragments and now that amount would become six in this area, meaning he could get a total of 30 Fragments from killing five wolves instead of 10 Fragments.
Considering how many Fragments he needed, this was a very useful title.
One slightly turned its head toward him.
There was still one more thing he had to do before entering the main area.
After the battle several hours ago, the amount of free stats points he had suddenly become very high.
He opened his status panel.
[Name: Lian Vorhelm.]
[Race: Human.]
[Level: 24.]
[Strength: 1300.]
[Spirit: 600.]
[Speed: 500.]
[Resistance: 725.]
[Free Stats Points: 1079.]
His eyes stayed mostly on Speed.
Five hundred.
For a long time, his Strength and Mana had become much higher than some of his other stats, but before this, the problem had not been so clear.
However, the battle with the Unborn Saint had clearly shown that if he could not react fast enough, having great power was not always useful.
Several times, only because of the difference in speed, he had been forced to use Thunder Step or Ash Step to save his life.
Spirit was also directly important for controlling skills like Frost Dominion and True Sequence.
Resistance too...
Lian remembered his own broken ribs, the Ancient Rank armor had helped a lot in this area but he should not forget that even that armor had a direct connection with his own Resistance.
Against opponents with much higher Levels, higher Resistance was also important.
He made his choices.
[Resistance: 725 → 900.]
[1050 Stats Points consumed.]
[Free Stats Points remaining: 29.]
[Total Base Stats: 5400.]
A familiar warmth spread through his entire body.
His muscles tightened for a few seconds and then relaxed again.
His bones and joints felt heavier, while the flow of Mana inside his body clearly moved more smoothly than a few moments ago.
But the biggest difference was Speed.
Lian took only one step, his body moved forward more than he expected.
He stopped for a moment and then moved again.
He had no problem controlling it, the System somehow allowed his body to quickly adapt to the increase in stats but the difference was still very clear.
One turned its large head toward him, as if wondering what exactly its master was doing and why they had stopped for so long.
"It’s nothing, we can move." Lian looked at it.
And they moved again.
The farther they went along Wolfcrown Road, the more signs of the old civilization appeared.
Stone pillars came out of the fog and broken towers could be seen among the trees.
Walls that had probably once been part of huge fortifications were now buried under dry roots and black moss.
But there was something familiar about the architecture to Lian, not because he had been here before.
But because he had read about it, spirals without a beginning or an end and buildings that were intentionally not built symmetrically.
Plazas with eight pillars and bridges that had eight sections and patterns that repeated the image of an eye or a hand many times in groups of eight.
A few minutes later, they passed through a large gate.
On the left side of the gate, the remains of a tall statue still existed, the statue was almost completely intact from the waist down.
The upper part of the body had suffered heavy damage, but the eight hands could still be recognized and several broken eyes also remained on the face.
Divine of Chaos.
Lian stopped for a moment, this was the second time he had personally reached areas clearly connected to one of the Seven Divines.
The first one was the Divine of Light.
The same ruin where Kain had been trapped and which later seemed to have even affected his Evolution path.
But the Divine of Chaos was not only connected to this Ruined Realm.
According to the information he had read from the reports of previous Ruined Realms, symbols and temples related to it had been seen in several different Ruined Realms.
This was one of the biggest questions for the researchers of Earth.
Were the Seven Divines really beings that were worshiped in several separate worlds?
Or had there once been a civilization that had spread their religion across different realms?

chapters.title: Chapter 484: The Wolfgrave Fortresses II
paragraphs: Both scenarios, even though they could seem as strange and impossible as possible, no longer seemed completely impossible or stupid after everything humanity had experienced.
However, there was still no answer, and it was not clear how much trace of the Divine of Chaos existed and still existed across all the Ruined Realms.
And all the remains and traditions related to it also seemed the same.
Two temples should not have been built exactly the same.
Two statues should not have had the same appearance.
The eight eyes of the Divine of Chaos were symbols of seeing different possibilities in most of the remaining writings.
And the eight hands represented the "Eight Paths of Change."
At least this was one of the translations that researchers on Earth agreed on more.
Lian moved a few steps closer to the statue but something other than the passage of time had damaged it here.
Its face had been deliberately scratched, two hands were broken, and another symbol had been carved over the old spiral symbol in the center of its chest.
A wolf crown.
He moved his eyes around, the same thing had happened in several other places where the remains or statues of this god were located.
The spirals had been buried under the Wolf Crown symbol and the statues of the Divine of Chaos had no heads.
Large wolf bones were hanging from some of the eight pillars.
Even one of the buildings that had probably once been a place of worship had now been turned into a huge nest with bones and fur.
"So the wolves were not the original owners of this place."
This place once belonged to a civilization that worshiped the Divine of Chaos.
Then something had changed, the civilization had disappeared, its symbols had been destroyed and now the castles belonged to something else.
The packs.
Lian gave the statue one last look and started moving again, he did not have the answer to that question for now but this place was probably not just a simple hunting area.
A few minutes later, Predator’s Instincts detected the presence of several creatures.
Seven of them were ahead.
He slowed down and One also got ready at the same moment.
The wolves came out of the fog, unlike the Gravehowls that were carrying corpses, this group was clearly guarding something.
Larger bodies, gray bones on their shoulders, long claws and blue and yellow eyes.
[Gravehowl Wolf.]
[Rank: Normal.]
[Level: 28.]
[Level: 29.]
[Level: 30.]
[Level: 30.]
[Level: 31.]
[Level: 31.]
[Level: 32.]
The seven wolves spread across the road but did not attack, one of the wolves showed its teeth, but its growl was weaker than it should have been.
Two others kept their bodies low and one of the Level 28 wolves even unconsciously took one step back.
And another wolf lowered its head for a moment.
It seemed they were afraid, just like the monsters he had seen before.
Normal monsters could feel the difference in status.
Even if the young Vorhelm looked like a human, to the instincts of monsters, something inside him was wrong.
He was above them, a Fallen Monster against Normal Monsters could lower their performance by up to twenty percent depending on the situation.
But its effect was not only a few numbers on the panel.
Fear.
Hesitation.
Delay in attacking.
An instinct telling them that the thing standing in front of them was not normal prey.
Lian gave a very small smile and when he saw that they were not going to attack first, he attacked first.
A rough howl came out of his throat, the pack tensed for a moment and the instinctive fear was pushed back.
And the Level 32 wolf also attacked back and the others immediately followed it.
The first wolf closed the distance in one jump, its mouth opened and its teeth came toward his neck but this time he did not need Thunder Step.
Lian’s head only moved a few centimeters to the left and the wolf’s jaws passed beside his face and the monster’s eyes opened slightly wider for a moment.
His hand grabbed its neck and his fingers closed, then a short turn happened.
Crack!
The wolf’s neck broke and its body fell to the ground without resistance.
[Gravehowl Wolf killed.]
[Base Reward: 2 Fragments.]
[Regional Multiplier: ×3.]
[6 Fragments received.]
[You received 207 stats points.]
Two wolves came at the same time, one from the right and the other from behind.
Lian raised his right leg, he did not even use his fist and his heel hit the skull of the wolf on the right.
Boom!
The monster’s head hit the ground and the stone under it broke and before the second wolf could close its jaws around his back, ice formed around his right hand.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
A blue arc flashed through the air.
Slash!
The wolf’s head was separated from its body and dark blood splashed onto the old road.
[6 Fragments received.]
[6 Fragments received.]
[You received 203 stats points.]
[You received 199 stats points.]
Four wolves remained and the hesitation on their faces was clearer, as if they were now more certain that attacking was stupid.
Three of their friends had been killed in the blink of an eye, and they understood that if they did not run, the same fate would happen to them.
One moved back and the second looked at the strongest wolf in the group.
Lian lowered his hands, One was still standing behind him, he did not even need to interfere.
"Are you afraid now?" he said with a mocking tone.
The Level 32 wolf growled and stared at him angrily, then moved forward again.
The young Vorhelm did not lose his smile.
"Too late."
[Thunder Step]
Boom!
His body disappeared and a moment later he was behind the wolf and the monster did not even have time to turn before Lian’s fist hit the back of its skull.
Boom!
The monster’s head was thrown forward and its neck broke at the same moment and just like that, the strongest wolf in the group was also killed.
The three remaining wolves scattered, they no longer had any interest in staying and each one quickly ran in a different direction.
One toward the forest and the other two toward the castles.
Lian slowly raised his palm.
[Frost Dominion]
Ice came out of the ground and blocked all their escape routes and then, before they could even understand what was happening, three large ice spears formed and pierced all three of them.
[6 Fragments received.]
[6 Fragments received.]
[6 Fragments received.]
[6 Fragments received.]
[You received 197 Stats points.]
[You received 203 stats points.]
[You received 209 stats points.]
[You received 197 stats points.]
From this small hunt alone, he had once again gained more than a thousand stats points and around 40 Fragments.
And this was only the first group inside the castles.
"Maybe I really will stay here for a while." He looked toward the fog, he had no problem clearing this entire place.
After all, he did not always get an opportunity like this.
One approached one of the corpses but before he could absorb the cores, another notification appeared.
Glutton.
[Extraction options detected.]
Three options appeared.
[Bone Claw.]
[Hunting Scent.]
[Silent Hunt.]
Lian’s eyes stopped on the third option.
[Silent Hunt.]
[By reducing the sound of movement, body smell and Mana leakage, detecting the user during pursuit and infiltration becomes much harder.]
[Using powerful attacks or releasing a large amount of Mana will disrupt the concealment effect.]
"Not bad."
He chose it.
[Silent Hunt Skill acquired.]
Then he reached the Level 32 wolf and Glutton gave him three choices again.
[Pack Roar.]
[Bone Trace.]
[Commandbreaker Howl.]
Lian opened the last explanation.
[Commandbreaker Howl.]
[A sound and Mana pressure that temporarily disrupts the coordination of creatures dependent on a group command.]
[Its effect is stronger against packs, colonies and weaker command structures.]
A small smile appeared on his face, with the Fallen Monster talent that lowered the performance of Normal Monsters by itself, this had an interesting combination.
Such a skill could be useful when he faced a large number of monsters at the same time.
"This one is not bad either."
[Commandbreaker Howl Skill acquired.]
He closed the panel and One had already opened the chests of the wolves during this time.
Several cores were lying on the ground and its master gave permission with a movement of his head.
One started absorbing them and the light of the cores entered its huge body one after another.
[Monster cores absorbed.]
[The saturation process of the First Evolution has progressed.]

Lian gave a very small smile and when he saw that they were not going to attack first, he attacked first.
A rough howl came out of his throat, the pack tensed for a moment and the instinctive fear was pushed back.
And the Level 32 wolf also attacked back and the others immediately followed it.
The first wolf closed the distance in one jump, its mouth opened and its teeth came toward his neck but this time he did not need Thunder Step.
Lian’s head only moved a few centimeters to the left and the wolf’s jaws passed beside his face and the monster’s eyes opened slightly wider for a moment.
His hand grabbed its neck and his fingers closed, then a short turn happened.
Crack!
The wolf’s neck broke and its body fell to the ground without resistance.
[Gravehowl Wolf killed.]
[Base Reward: 2 Fragments.]
[Regional Multiplier: ×3.]
[6 Fragments received.]
[You received 207 stats points.]
Two wolves came at the same time, one from the right and the other from behind.
Lian raised his right leg, he did not even use his fist and his heel hit the skull of the wolf on the right.
Boom!
The monster’s head hit the ground and the stone under it broke and before the second wolf could close its jaws around his back, ice formed around his right hand.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
A blue arc flashed through the air.
Slash!
The wolf’s head was separated from its body and dark blood splashed onto the old road.
[6 Fragments received.]
[6 Fragments received.]
[You received 203 stats points.]
[You received 199 stats points.]
Four wolves remained and the hesitation on their faces was clearer, as if they were now more certain that attacking was stupid.
Three of their friends had been killed in the blink of an eye, and they understood that if they did not run, the same fate would happen to them.
One moved back and the second looked at the strongest wolf in the group.
Lian lowered his hands, One was still standing behind him, he did not even need to interfere.
"Are you afraid now?" he said with a mocking tone.
The Level 32 wolf growled and stared at him angrily, then moved forward again.
The young Vorhelm did not lose his smile.
"Too late."
[Thunder Step]
Boom!
His body disappeared and a moment later he was behind the wolf and the monster did not even have time to turn before Lian’s fist hit the back of its skull.
Boom!
The monster’s head was thrown forward and its neck broke at the same moment and just like that, the strongest wolf in the group was also killed.
The three remaining wolves scattered, they no longer had any interest in staying and each one quickly ran in a different direction.
One toward the forest and the other two toward the castles.
Lian slowly raised his palm.
[Frost Dominion]
Ice came out of the ground and blocked all their escape routes and then, before they could even understand what was happening, three large ice spears formed and pierced all three of them.
[6 Fragments received.]
[6 Fragments received.]
[6 Fragments received.]
[6 Fragments received.]
[You received 197 Stats points.]
[You received 203 stats points.]
[You received 209 stats points.]
[You received 197 stats points.]
From this small hunt alone, he had once again gained more than a thousand stats points and around 40 Fragments.
And this was only the first group inside the castles.
"Maybe I really will stay here for a while." He looked toward the fog, he had no problem clearing this entire place.
After all, he did not always get an opportunity like this.
One approached one of the corpses but before he could absorb the cores, another notification appeared.
Glutton.
[Extraction options detected.]
Three options appeared.
[Bone Claw.]
[Hunting Scent.]
[Silent Hunt.]
Lian’s eyes stopped on the third option.
[Silent Hunt.]
[By reducing the sound of movement, body smell and Mana leakage, detecting the user during pursuit and infiltration becomes much harder.]
[Using powerful attacks or releasing a large amount of Mana will disrupt the concealment effect.]
"Not bad."
He chose it.
[Silent Hunt Skill acquired.]
Then he reached the Level 32 wolf and Glutton gave him three choices again.
[Pack Roar.]
[Bone Trace.]
[Commandbreaker Howl.]
Lian opened the last explanation.
[Commandbreaker Howl.]
[A sound and Mana pressure that temporarily disrupts the coordination of creatures dependent on a group command.]
[Its effect is stronger against packs, colonies and weaker command structures.]
A small smile appeared on his face, with the Fallen Monster talent that lowered the performance of Normal Monsters by itself, this had an interesting combination.
Such a skill could be useful when he faced a large number of monsters at the same time.
"This one is not bad either."
[Commandbreaker Howl Skill acquired.]
He closed the panel and One had already opened the chests of the wolves during this time.
Several cores were lying on the ground and its master gave permission with a movement of his head.
One started absorbing them and the light of the cores entered its huge body one after another.
[Monster cores absorbed.]
[The saturation process of the First Evolution has progressed.]

chapters.title: Chapter 485: The Wolfgrave Fortresses III
paragraphs: [Monster cores were absorbed.]
[The First Evolution saturation process has progressed.]
Another progress, but they were still far from complete, but it was not a problem, with the number of wolves he had seen so far, a lack of cores was the last thing they needed to worry about.
He did not forget to put the corpses into his storage space as well, they could be a delicious meal for the Devourer Egg.
They moved along the road for a few more minutes until the ground became higher.
Finally, Lian climbed over a half-collapsed wall, and there, for the first time, he saw all of the Wolfgrave Castles.
His eyes slowly moved across the scene, it was not one fortress, it was not even two or three fortresses and the old walls continued for kilometers through the mist.
Watchtowers stood at different points, some were half-destroyed, some had completely collapsed and some were still strangely intact.
Several smaller castles stood around the area and old roads connected them to the central area.
But all of them looked small compared to what stood in the middle of the whole area.
Wolfcrown Fortress.
Its huge stone walls were almost a hundred meters high even from this close distance.
Eight old towers stood around the central building.
And on the highest tower was the Crown.
Now that he was closer, Lian could clearly see that it was not a statue, it was a real structure.
It was made from a dark material between metal and bone and had several curved branches that pointed toward the sky like huge teeth.
Faint mana lines moved across its surface.
The Celestial Book of Treasure inside his storage space started to shake.
He took it out, and the book almost opened by itself. A purple light from the page pointed directly toward the Crown.
[Treasure confirmed.]
[Location: Crown of the Central Fortress.]
[Rank: Cannot be evaluated, touch it for final inspection.]
Lian stayed silent for a few seconds, reaching the place where the Crown was would not be easy and his eyes moved down.
Wolves.
Dozens.
Hundreds.
They were moving between the castles from different paths, some were carrying corpses and some were guarding the walls.
Some were simply sitting in the courtyards.
He could also sense several stronger presences, Level 35, 36 and maybe even 38.
For now, he did not plan to turn the entire area against himself, at least not yet, even though he suspected that such a thing might happen.
His eyes moved toward One.
A several-meter-tall giant ant, even with the best stealth skill in the world, was not a good choice for sneaking through hundreds of wolves.
He sent a command through the bond and One resisted for a moment.
"Just for now."
At the same moment, the giant ant turned into particles of light and disappeared.
[Special Member of the Colony — One.]
[Status: Inside the Colony House.]
Now he was alone and activated his new skill.
[Silent Hunt.]
The change was not instant, but when he took a step, it made no sound, the natural leak of his mana decreased and even his body smell and presence became much weaker.
It was almost impossible for ordinary monsters to detect him anymore.
Then he moved forward.
Lian did not use the main path, instead he moved across the walls.
He passed over the rooftops of broken buildings and used parts of the old architecture to move above several packs.
None of the wolves below noticed him and the closer he got to the center, the older and stranger the architecture became.
In the outer castles, there were more signs of the wolves.
Bones.
Fur.
Claw marks.
Crown symbols.
But near the central area, the past had not been completely erased yet and eight stone bridges led toward the main fortress.
Eight towers stood around the central square, eight paths from different directions ended at the same place.
On some walls, under the new scratches and marks, the old spiral could still be seen.
Divine of Chaos.
He took out World Memory, and the map shook for a moment.
Part of the information that had been damaged until now was restored again because he was getting closer to the main area.
[Historical structure identified.]
[Old Name: Shelter of Eight Paths.]
[Affiliation: Followers of Divine of Chaos.]
[The remaining information is damaged.]
He stopped for a moment and looked at the information.
Shelter of Eight Paths, so even the name "Wolfgrave Castles" was not the original name of this place.
The System had probably named it based on the current state of the area.
In the past, this place belonged to the followers of Divine of Chaos, this also confirmed that his guess was correct and now, however, no humans walked through its streets.
There were no priests beside the statues and the eight paths of change were buried under the packs’ paws.
His eyes moved toward the central Crown, and another question appeared in his mind.
Did the Crown also belong to the same civilization? Or was it something that was added to this place later, after their fall?
The Celestial Book only said that it was a treasure and did not give more information, but it could really be an amazing discovery if it belonged to an ancient civilization.
He moved again and about ten minutes later, he reached one of the courtyards near the central fortress.
He stood on top of a half-broken wall and below him was a huge number of wolves, several packs had gathered in a large courtyard and with only one look, he counted more than a hundred.
Gray Wolves.
Gravehowl Wolves.
Several larger types that had more bones growing on their bodies and even several almost three-meter-tall monsters stood at the back of the courtyard.
Some of the wolves were carrying corpses, some were sitting in silence and some were simply staring at the huge door of the central fortress.
...As if they were waiting for something.

Silent Hunt was still active and no one was looking up, so he did not need to worry about being discovered, after all, fighting this huge number of wolves, most of which were above Level 30, would not be easy even for him.

He slowly moved along the wall and the distance to one of the bridges leading to the main fortress was not far anymore, if he continued like this, he might even enter the central area without a fight.
But at that exact moment ...Boom!
A deep pulse came out from inside the fortress.
Lian stopped right there, what he felt was not a sound, it was more like a wave of mana that passed through the walls and went directly through his body.
Silent Hunt was still active, his mana leak was almost zero, his smell was impossible to track and he had made no sound.
Even so, something happened below and the black bone behind the neck of one of the Gravehowl Wolves lit up.
Then the second.
The third.
Ten.
Thirty.
Fifty.
And within a few seconds, almost all of the black bones inside the courtyard lit up at the same time with a faint light.
Lian frowned, he also did not know exactly what had happened, but his instinct told him that whatever had happened, it was not a good thing.
And just as he expected what had happened ... suddenly the first wolf raised its head and its dead blue eye locked directly onto him.
The second one also looked ...then the third and the movement spread through the pack like a wave.
Dozens of heads slowly turned upward and in less than five seconds, the entire courtyard became silent and more than a hundred pairs of blue, white and yellow eyes were fixed on the top of the wall.
At Lian.
He looked down at them without moving, the path behind him was still open and the central fortress was in front of him and below was a small army of wolf monsters.
And suddenly, a howl came from the depths of the central fortress.
This time, unlike the howls from the nearby forest, it was very close and the sound was so deep that even the stone under Lian’s feet shook a little.
The wolves in the courtyard showed their teeth one after another and growls filled the area.
Young Vorhelm looked at the scene below for a few seconds and then a very calm smile appeared on his face.
"Well... the stealth went well until now."

chapters.title: Chapter 486: The Wolfgrave Fortresses IV
paragraphs: "Well... the hiding went well until now." Lian said with a calm smile.
For a few seconds, nothing happened.
Then the first growl was heard.
A wolf near the center of the courtyard showed its teeth, but instead of attacking, it lowered its ears. Another one took half a step back, and an even smaller wolf lowered its head for a moment.
This reaction was not unfamiliar to him, even though there were so many of them, he could still feel the instinctive fear they had toward him.
The creatures in front of him were all ordinary monsters.

All of them were at a higher level than him, but level was not the only thing monsters could understand. Something deeper than numbers and stats inside their bodies allowed them to sense the difference in rank.
At that moment...Awooooooooooooo—!
A deep howl came from inside the central fortress, and the stone under Lian’s feet shook, the black bone behind the neck of the first wolf began to glow.
Then the second.
The third.
In less than a few seconds, dozens of pieces of bone began to glow with the same weak blue-black light.
The wolves’ behavior immediately changed.
The fear that had been in their movements moments ago disappeared as if someone had pulled it out of their minds with their hand.
Their ears rose and their muscles tightened, their claws scratched against the stone, and one of the wolves jumped onto the wall...then another.
And suddenly, the entire courtyard came alive.
The young Vorhelm had still not moved and instead, he opened the System panel.
[Strength: 1500.]
[Speed: 800.]
[Resistance: 900.]
[Stats points: 1544.]
One hundred points had come from reaching level twenty-four and twenty-nine points had remained from before.
And another one thousand four hundred and fifteen points were the result of Butcher after killing the seven previous wolves.
Only seven monsters had given him such a large amount of stats.
The first evolution had truly taken the natural skills of the monster class to another level.
The sound of claws climbing over the wall became closer and he calmly chose the options.
[Resistance: 900 → 1200.]
[1544 stats points consumed.]
[Free stats points remaining: 0.]
[Total Base Stats: 6944.]
A strong heat spread through his body.
His muscles tightened for a few moments and his bones felt heavier under his skin.
The flow of mana inside his veins became faster and his senses became so clear for a fraction of a second that he could distinguish the sound of every single wolf’s claws touching the stone.
The first wolf had almost reached the top of the wall and he finally closed the panel.
"Alright."
The storage space opened.
A dark mass spread around his body and in the blink of an eye, black and gray plates locked onto his chest, arms, legs, and shoulders.
[World-Devourer Bastion activated.]
[Mountain Frame is active.]
[Giant’s Momentum is active.]
The wolf monster finally reached the top of the wall.
"Come at me now." Naturally, to fight this many monsters with levels like these, he had to be in his best condition.
But he was not going to fight alone and the Hive Link activated.
[Special Hive member selected.]
[One.]
[Level: 20.]
[Evolution Saturation Status: Partial.]
[Summoning begins.]
Particles of light gathered beside Lian.
Boom!
One’s huge body landed on the wall and cracks spread under its six powerful legs.
Several wolves that had almost reached the top of the wall stopped instinctively when they saw the several-meter-tall creature.
One’s antennae moved as it looked at the large group of wolf monsters and then a simple command reached its mind through the link.
The cores are yours.
The giant ant’s antennae rose and the young Vorhelm took one step forward from the edge and ...then jumped, One also jumped down behind him.
And both of them jumped directly toward the pack.
The wolves expected the surrounded human to try to create distance.
That was their mistake.
Lian opened his right hand in the air.
[Frost Dominion]
Crack!
The first wall of ice rose from the floor of the courtyard.
Then the second.
The third.
The fourth.
But he did not freeze the entire area, there was no need.
The walls grew at precise angles and divided the large courtyard into several narrow paths within a few seconds.
The group of more than one hundred wolves was no longer one pack, but had been divided into groups of seven or eight.
The movement of the wolves behind interfered with the wolves in front, some were forced to go around and some were trapped behind the ice walls.
"Numbers only matter when you can attack at the same time." He landed on the ground.
The first three wolves entered the path.
[Level: 31.]
[Level: 32.]
[Level: 32.]
They did not wait even one second and all three attacked.
He disappeared.
[Thunder Step]
Boom!
He appeared among them and the first wolf only had time to narrow its pupils.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
A large arc of blue ice formed in front of Lian and with one movement ...shhhhhrrrk!
Two bodies were almost split in half at the same time and dark blood splashed onto the ice walls.
The third wolf opened its mouth from the left, he did not dodge and his shoulder moved down.
[Iron Fortress Charge]
The entire weight of the World-Devourer Bastion along with Giant’s Momentum was behind the impact.
Kaaaaaboooom!
The level thirty-two wolf’s body was sent backward like a projectile and crashed into the wolf behind it.
Both of them crashed into the third one and in the end, four monsters were thrown several meters across the ground together and did not get up again ...
[6+ Fragments]
[6+ Fragments]
[6+ Fragments]
[6+ Fragments]
[201 stats points obtained]
[203 stats points obtained]
[200 stats points obtained]
[191 stats points obtained]
Lian did not even look at them and turned his attention toward the other side of the battlefield, One was fighting two wolf monsters.
One had jumped onto the natural armor on its back and another was trying to bite its rear leg joint.
Instead of attacking directly, the giant ant lowered its huge body...it became still for a moment and suddenly spun with all its weight.
Booooom!
And the two wolves were sent directly into the ice wall.
Crack!
Boom!
Through Hive Dominion, the young Vorhelm could feel the condition of One’s entire body.

It had received a few small wounds but there was no serious danger, to make sure nothing happened, he created several ice spears and sent them toward the two wolves, wounding them badly enough to kill them.
After that, he turned his attention back to the next group, five wolves were coming through the narrow path.
One of them was slightly behind and seemed to be the strongest, and the movement of the others was based on its position.
[False Presence]
His presence split and one Lian went to the left while another went to the right.
The wolves hesitated for only a fraction of a second but that was enough.
And he suddenly appeared behind the leader.
[Thunder Calamity]
His fist disappeared inside blue-purple lightning.
Bــــoom!
The wolf’s skull exploded and without their leader, the other four lost their rhythm for a moment.
And the pressure of the Fallen Monster showed itself again, the first wolf stopped because of fear and the second moved backward.
Using this fear and confusion, he opened both hands.
[Cataclysm Pulse]
Booooooom!
The shockwave exploded through the ice corridor and four wolves were lifted from the ground, one crashed directly into the ice wall and its spine broke.
The other two fell on top of each other and the formation of the pack completely fell apart.
Lian walked through them and the notifications appeared in front of him.
[6 Fragments received.]
[6 Fragments received.]
[6 Fragments received.]
[6+ Fragments]
[6+ Fragments]
[201 stats points obtained]
[188 stats points obtained]
[196 stats points obtained]
Only a few seconds had passed since the battle began when the number of notifications became annoying.
"Summarize the repeated rewards until the end of the battle." He said while pushing away another wolf’s claw.
[Request recorded.]
[Display of repeated rewards has been stopped until the end of the battle.]
"Much better."
A growl came from above and Lian looked up.
A wolf almost three meters tall had jumped over one of the ice walls.
[Boneback Wolf.]
[Level: 35.]
Its huge jaws closed directly toward his head.
If it hit him, it could be dangerous but the teeth never touched anything, they did not have the chance to do so ...and his body turned into ash at the last moment.
[Ash Step]
The wolf passed through the pile of ash and its feet reached the ground.
Behind it, the ash formed the human body again and the young Vorhelm placed one hand on the back of the monster’s skull.
Glacial Reaper Claw formed from point-blank range.
Crack!
The ice broke through the skin and bones at the same time and the wolf’s head was separated from its neck and rolled several meters across the icy floor.
Without looking at the body, he moved toward the next enemy.
[7 Fragments obtained]
[215 stats points obtained]
It seemed that this one, besides the Wolf Slayer reward, had also dropped one extra Fragment by itself ...

The first wolf had almost reached the top of the wall and he finally closed the panel.
"Alright."
The storage space opened.
A dark mass spread around his body and in the blink of an eye, black and gray plates locked onto his chest, arms, legs, and shoulders.
[World-Devourer Bastion activated.]
[Mountain Frame is active.]
[Giant’s Momentum is active.]
The wolf monster finally reached the top of the wall.
"Come at me now." Naturally, to fight this many monsters with levels like these, he had to be in his best condition.
But he was not going to fight alone and the Hive Link activated.
[Special Hive member selected.]
[One.]
[Level: 20.]
[Evolution Saturation Status: Partial.]
[Summoning begins.]
Particles of light gathered beside Lian.
Boom!
One’s huge body landed on the wall and cracks spread under its six powerful legs.
Several wolves that had almost reached the top of the wall stopped instinctively when they saw the several-meter-tall creature.
One’s antennae moved as it looked at the large group of wolf monsters and then a simple command reached its mind through the link.
The cores are yours.
The giant ant’s antennae rose and the young Vorhelm took one step forward from the edge and ...then jumped, One also jumped down behind him.
And both of them jumped directly toward the pack.
The wolves expected the surrounded human to try to create distance.
That was their mistake.
Lian opened his right hand in the air.
[Frost Dominion]
Crack!
The first wall of ice rose from the floor of the courtyard.
Then the second.
The third.
The fourth.
But he did not freeze the entire area, there was no need.
The walls grew at precise angles and divided the large courtyard into several narrow paths within a few seconds.
The group of more than one hundred wolves was no longer one pack, but had been divided into groups of seven or eight.
The movement of the wolves behind interfered with the wolves in front, some were forced to go around and some were trapped behind the ice walls.
"Numbers only matter when you can attack at the same time." He landed on the ground.
The first three wolves entered the path.
[Level: 31.]
[Level: 32.]
[Level: 32.]
They did not wait even one second and all three attacked.
He disappeared.
[Thunder Step]
Boom!
He appeared among them and the first wolf only had time to narrow its pupils.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
A large arc of blue ice formed in front of Lian and with one movement ...shhhhhrrrk!
Two bodies were almost split in half at the same time and dark blood splashed onto the ice walls.
The third wolf opened its mouth from the left, he did not dodge and his shoulder moved down.
[Iron Fortress Charge]
The entire weight of the World-Devourer Bastion along with Giant’s Momentum was behind the impact.
Kaaaaaboooom!
The level thirty-two wolf’s body was sent backward like a projectile and crashed into the wolf behind it.
Both of them crashed into the third one and in the end, four monsters were thrown several meters across the ground together and did not get up again ...
[6+ Fragments]
[6+ Fragments]
[6+ Fragments]
[6+ Fragments]
[201 stats points obtained]
[203 stats points obtained]
[200 stats points obtained]
[191 stats points obtained]
Lian did not even look at them and turned his attention toward the other side of the battlefield, One was fighting two wolf monsters.
One had jumped onto the natural armor on its back and another was trying to bite its rear leg joint.
Instead of attacking directly, the giant ant lowered its huge body...it became still for a moment and suddenly spun with all its weight.
Booooom!
And the two wolves were sent directly into the ice wall.
Crack!
Boom!
Through Hive Dominion, the young Vorhelm could feel the condition of One’s entire body.

It had received a few small wounds but there was no serious danger, to make sure nothing happened, he created several ice spears and sent them toward the two wolves, wounding them badly enough to kill them.
After that, he turned his attention back to the next group, five wolves were coming through the narrow path.
One of them was slightly behind and seemed to be the strongest, and the movement of the others was based on its position.
[False Presence]
His presence split and one Lian went to the left while another went to the right.
The wolves hesitated for only a fraction of a second but that was enough.
And he suddenly appeared behind the leader.
[Thunder Calamity]
His fist disappeared inside blue-purple lightning.
Bــــoom!
The wolf’s skull exploded and without their leader, the other four lost their rhythm for a moment.
And the pressure of the Fallen Monster showed itself again, the first wolf stopped because of fear and the second moved backward.
Using this fear and confusion, he opened both hands.
[Cataclysm Pulse]
Booooooom!
The shockwave exploded through the ice corridor and four wolves were lifted from the ground, one crashed directly into the ice wall and its spine broke.
The other two fell on top of each other and the formation of the pack completely fell apart.
Lian walked through them and the notifications appeared in front of him.
[6 Fragments received.]
[6 Fragments received.]
[6 Fragments received.]
[6+ Fragments]
[6+ Fragments]
[201 stats points obtained]
[188 stats points obtained]
[196 stats points obtained]
Only a few seconds had passed since the battle began when the number of notifications became annoying.
"Summarize the repeated rewards until the end of the battle." He said while pushing away another wolf’s claw.
[Request recorded.]
[Display of repeated rewards has been stopped until the end of the battle.]
"Much better."
A growl came from above and Lian looked up.
A wolf almost three meters tall had jumped over one of the ice walls.
[Boneback Wolf.]
[Level: 35.]
Its huge jaws closed directly toward his head.
If it hit him, it could be dangerous but the teeth never touched anything, they did not have the chance to do so ...and his body turned into ash at the last moment.
[Ash Step]
The wolf passed through the pile of ash and its feet reached the ground.
Behind it, the ash formed the human body again and the young Vorhelm placed one hand on the back of the monster’s skull.
Glacial Reaper Claw formed from point-blank range.
Crack!
The ice broke through the skin and bones at the same time and the wolf’s head was separated from its neck and rolled several meters across the icy floor.
Without looking at the body, he moved toward the next enemy.
[7 Fragments obtained]
[215 stats points obtained]
It seemed that this one, besides the Wolf Slayer reward, had also dropped one extra Fragment by itself ...

chapters.title: Chapter 487: The Wolfgrave Fortresses V
paragraphs: The corridors that Lian had created with Frost Dominion did not allow the number of wolves to become their real advantage.
Every time, he faced a few wolves step by step, five, seven and sometimes even ten of them, but he never faced one hundred at the same time.
Until almost twenty wolves were lying on the ground.
The hunt was going well and if he continued like this, all the wolf monsters would be dead within a few dozen minutes at most.
Then ...Awooooooooo!
A howl came from the west.
He raised his eyes for a moment and the gate of one of the nearby fortresses had opened and suddenly dozens of shadows came out from behind it.
Thirty.
Maybe forty wolves.
"Hmm."
Another howl came from the east...another group could be seen.
Then there was movement on the southern walls, a new pack was coming from the walls toward the courtyard.
Lian looked at them for a few seconds and understood the problem.
"Oh... well, this was not something I expected."
He was not killing one pack, all the fortresses were reacting to his presence and every howl was summoning another group.
Every black bone that lit up was spreading the message even further.
He could kill one hundred wolves, maybe two hundred...but what if there were one thousand of them across the fortresses? It was useless.
How was he supposed to deal with more than one thousand wolf monsters, most of them above level 30? He was even surprised about what kind of monster could control such a huge number of wolf monsters.
His first guess was that the Boss here was a Fallen, but little by little he was starting to feel that it might be an Unholy.
One made a rough sound from the other side of the battlefield.

The young Vorhelm checked its condition, it was still fine, but the pressure on it was also increasing, it had obtained twenty monster cores until now but even so, its evolution condition was still not complete.
The next pack entered one of the ice corridors and their leader wolf was at the very front.
[Gravehowl Commander Wolf.]
[Level: 36.]
Twelve more wolves were behind it and at that moment it howled and the pack moved.
Lian also moved forward, his base speed of one thousand two hundred was now fully showing itself and he easily closed the distance without using Thunder Step.
The Commander Wolf swung its claw and he lowered his body only slightly, the claw passed over his face guard.
His right fist went directly into the monster’s chest.
A strike using only the pure power of one thousand eight hundred.
Boom!
Its chest caved in, but the wolf was still alive and its jaws came toward Lian’s shoulder and he allowed it to get close.
[Thunder Calamity]
Kaboom!
Lightning exploded directly inside the wolf’s body from his fist that was buried inside it and the monster’s eyes lit up for a moment ...then went dark as its body fell to the ground.
[6 Fragments obtained.]
[214 stats points obtained.]
And at that moment, all twelve wolves behind it stopped, as if they had not expected their Commander to be killed so easily and their instinctive fear was awakened by the death of their leader.
And for Lian, two seconds was more than enough to use it and create an opportunity.
He opened both hands.
[Frost Dominion.]
Crack!
The feet of six wolves froze to the ground and he moved between them and raised his hand, a huge ice claw formed and within those same two seconds, three monsters were slaughtered.
[18 Fragments obtained.]
[724 stats points obtained.]
The pack had just started to regain its coordination when the young Vorhelm moved again.
He continued killing the monsters like this without giving them any chance.
But a few minutes later, another enemy appeared.
A level 37 wolf.
Its body was thinner than the others, but its chest was covered with bone blades.
When it attacked, two bone plates opened from the sides of its jaw and created something similar to a second jaw.
After a short fight, Lian cut its neck with Glacial Reaper Claw.
Gluttony activated again.
[Extraction options detected.]
[Corpse Skin.]
[Bone Tooth.]
[Grave Fang.]
He read the skill description.
[Grave Fang.]
[By consuming mana, two large mana jaws are formed around the target and close from two directions at the same time.]
[Grave Fang received.]
The chance to test it came only a few seconds later.
A level 38 wolf jumped from the top of the wall toward One, the giant ant had no chance against this monster at level 20.
Lian opened his hand.
Grave Fang.
Two huge and semi-transparent jaws appeared on both sides of the monster’s body.
Crack!
They closed at the same time, the wolf stopped in the middle of the air for a moment and the sound of its bones breaking was very clear.
One raised its head and took the chance, its real jaws closed around the wolf’s throat.
Crack!
"Useful."
One sent a feeling of satisfaction through the link but the pressure from the other enemies could no longer be ignored.
Lian pushed one wolf away with his fist, at the same moment another monster scratched its claw across the shoulder plate of the World-Devourer Bastion.
Krrrrrk!
A thin crack appeared on the armor and a third wolf bit his left arm, its teeth locked onto the forearm plate.
It created an opening for a moment and that was enough for three more wolves to attack from three directions.
The young Vorhelm narrowed his eyes.
[Cataclysm Pulse]
Boooooooooom!
The shockwave came out from his body and the wolf attached to his arm was thrown backward with its jaw broken.
The other three attackers were also pushed several meters back and Lian took one step forward, despite his clear individual advantage, the problem was obvious.
If there were five or ten wolves, killing them was simple, if there were twenty, it would take a little time.
But when every group he killed was replaced by two more groups, the problem was no longer power, it was time and resources.
His eyes turned toward the central fortress, there was something there that was controlling all these packs.
So instead of cutting the branches, it was better to find the root.
His eyes fell on one of the half-ruined towers on the northern side, there were deep cracks around its base and the two main entrances to the courtyard were directly in line with it.
[True Sequence]
The structure of the tower in front of his mind opened, the weak point, the main pillar and the old crack, he could see everything.
"Found you." He smiled.
His hand touched the nearby wall.
[Frost Dominion]
The cold passed through the surface, into the cracks and inside the base of the tower, the ice moved through the structure like white roots.
The wolves continued attacking and Lian held them back with one hand while with the other [Thunder Calamity]
Krrrrrrrr!
Lightning entered the base through the ice network.
For a moment, nothing happened.
Then...Crack!
The main pillar broke, the tower shook and the newly arrived wolves under it raised their heads for a moment.
But it was already too late for them to do anything, the several-hundred-year-old tower leaned toward the path Lian had calculated.
Kaaaaaaaabooooooom!
Thousands of tons of stone collapsed and the entire western entrance was buried under the rubble, half of the eastern path was also blocked.
Dozens of wolves were trapped behind the stone wall and a wave of dust covered the entire courtyard.
He sent a command through the link, One, come back, the giant ant crushed the last wolf in front of it under its feet and then turned into particles of light.
[One returned to the Hive Home.]
Now the young Vorhelm no longer needed to pay attention to another path, he had one target.
The central fortress.
And he moved.
The wolves understood almost immediately.
Lian passed through the dust and howls rose behind him, dozens of claws scratched against the stones and wolves also started running on the walls on both sides.
This was no longer a battle, it was a chase, they could not allow their King to be in danger.
He stepped onto the stone bridge and a wolf threw itself down from the tower on the right.
[Ash Step]
His body turned into ash and the monster passed through it and hit the floor of the bridge.
Lian formed four meters ahead but at that moment a large wolf blocked his path from the front.
[Grave Fang]
Two mana jaws formed around it.
Boom!
The monster was crushed between them and he passed beside it without stopping.
Another wolf approached from the left side.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
A blue arc passed through the air and blood splashed onto the stones.
Two shadows fell from above and tried to block his path but even they could not catch him at their full speed.
[Thunder Step]
Boom!
He appeared fifty meters ahead and the sound of the howls was still behind him.
And the central fortress was getting closer and much closer.
When he reached the foot of the huge gate, the battle summary notification appeared.
[Current battle has ended.]
[Wolf-type creatures killed by you: 38.]
[Fragments obtained: 228]
[Total Fragments: 361]
He slowed down for a moment.
He had more than 300 fragments again, but it was still very little, still far too little for everything he wanted to use them for.
