chapters.title: Chapter 488: Wolf Of Eight Disasters
paragraphs: After that, he took his eyes away from the notifications, the wolves behind him were getting closer and he did not want to waste any more time.
He passed through the gate and at that exact moment, something strange happened.
The wolf monsters stopped.
He took a few more steps but there was truly no longer any sound of claws, he turned his head and saw dozens of wolves standing right behind the entrance of the fortress.
They showed their teeth, growled, and some had even lowered their bodies and it was clear that they wanted to attack.
But none of them stepped inside, not even the Gravehowl wolves.
The young Vorhelm looked at them for a few seconds, the pressure of his Fallen Talent was not the reason for this behavior, this fear came from somewhere else.
Whatever the reason was, it was behind him, inside the fortress, whatever was inside was so terrifying to these monsters that they did not dare to enter its territory because of their fear.
He slowly turned around and looked more carefully, he was still not sure whether there was an Unholy inside or not, but whatever it was, it was definitely not weak.
The inside of the fortress was much larger than what it looked like from outside.
The ceiling of the hall was almost fifty meters high.
Eight huge pillars stretched from the floor to the ceiling and on each one, there were worn carvings of a creature with eight eyes and eight arms.
Divine of Chaos.
But something had polluted these old remains, wolf bones were hanging from the walls and skulls were placed inside the cracks of the pillars.
Some spiral symbols had been scratched by claws and in the middle of the hall, a huge circle had been carved into the floor.
Eight stone paths reached it from eight different directions.
Lian raised his head, from inside the ceiling, the lower part of the same huge crown could be seen, the distance was much smaller now.
Black strands came down from the structure of the crown, a network of dark lines had entered the stone.
He activated True Sequence and the paths became clear.
The crown, the pillars, the eight paths, the central circle and then the strands connected to them all went down, underground and toward one point.
Whatever it was, it was down there.
The Heavenly Book of Treasures reacted inside the storage space, before Lian could even take it out...Boom!
The entire hall shook.
The same pulse, but this time it was so close that it entered directly into his bones from the floor.
A few pieces of dust fell from the ceiling and then a sound came from underground.
Breathing.
The sound of long, deep and heavy breathing.
"Hــــــــــــــah..."
His hunter instincts activated immediately but what they sent him was different from the warning given by the monsters outside.
It was as if they were warning him that whatever was there, it was a great hunter.
He looked toward the end of the hall, behind two broken pillars, a huge staircase went down.
He stood there for a few seconds and then moved, in any case, he did not care and was not that worried, he had seen things that had made him somewhat numb to almost anything.
With every step he went down, the pressure became stronger, the air was also heavy and the smell of a beast could be felt from it.
The walls of the stairs were covered with black chains and on every ring, the spiral symbol of the Divine of Chaos could be seen.
The farther down he went, the thicker the chains became.
Finally, the stairs ended.
Lian entered a hall that was even larger than the upper hall and stopped there.
Something was sleeping in the darkness, at first he only saw its size.
And then [Night Eyes] made the details clearer.
Its body was almost fifteen meters long.
It was a wolf.
But if someone used only this word to describe it, almost all of the truth would be lost.
The creature’s fur had probably once been black, but now it had changed between burned gray and dead black.
Parts of the skin on its sides and chest were completely missing and something like bone armor was coming out from under the flesh.
Its ribs were far too long.
Some of them had passed through the skin and grown like curved horns along its sides.
Each of its front claws was almost the size of a human body and its black nails had sunk several centimeters into the stone even while it was sleeping.
But the head was the worst part, it had a huge and long skull, its mouth was closed, but even in that state, two rows of teeth were sticking out from between its rotten lips.
Not one row, like every other normal creature, but two rows, as if another jaw had grown inside the first jaw.
And there were eight eyes on its face, four eyes on each side and four eyes on the other side and all of them were closed.
Eight long bone blades came out from the back of its head and were placed around its skull like an uneven crown.
But unlike the crown of normal wolves, these did not look natural.
On each blade, thin lines similar to the same Divine of Chaos spirals had been carved.
Huge black chains were wrapped around the creature’s neck, legs, chest and spine.
Some had passed directly through its bones.
Several chains had even entered its flesh and come out from the other side.
It was as if someone had imprisoned this creature.
No ...
This creature had not only been sealed, they had wanted to make sure that even if it tore apart all of its flesh, it still could not escape.
Black veins came out from its spine and entered the floor of the hall.
Lian followed their path with True Sequence, this was the network!
The same thing that was connected to the black bones behind the necks of all the Gravehowl wolves ...the source of the command was here.
The System finally showed its information.
[Wolf Of Eight Disaster.]
[Rank: Fallen ( Unholy ) ]
[Level: 40.]
Lian looked at the panel for a few seconds.
Level forty.
The level difference was sixteen.
And something about this creature’s appearance said that even among Fallen monsters, it was probably not normal.
And the Unholy written in parentheses explained by itself that this creature was definitely different from every Fallen he had seen.
His eyes moved over the chains.
The symbols of the Divine of Chaos.
This was more important than the level, this wolf had not been worshiped by the followers of the Divine of Chaos, it had been imprisoned.
The civilization that had once built the Sanctuary of the Eightfold Paths had buried this thing under the city with chains that were still active after all these years.
But the civilization had been destroyed, although the prison remained and the imprisoned creature had connected all the wolves in the area to itself from inside that same prison.
Instead of escaping, it had built a territory for itself.
Then the young Vorhelm raised his head slightly, another mana strand went directly from Eightfold Fang’s body to the ceiling.
To the crown.
He took out the Celestial Book of Treasures and the pages immediately opened.
[A treasure is located nearby.]
[Final examination requires direct contact with the crown.]
He also activated the World Memory, hoping to see whether he could obtain information with the help of this artifact and the map.
World Memory could practically bring the map to life and add old and historical details to it.
In the end, part of the worn information was recovered.
[Historical structure identified.]
[Eightfold Containment System.]
[The crown is part of the containment structure.]
His eyes narrowed slightly, so the problem was clear, the treasure he had come here for was probably the same thing that was keeping this creature here.
If he took the crown... the chains might stop working.
Lian looked at the huge creature for a few seconds and then let out a short sigh.
"Of course."
And at that exact moment ...Crack!
A small sound spread through the hall and suddenly one of the chains around the creature’s neck moved.
He became completely still.
The first eye on the right side of the skull slowly opened and a thin golden pupil appeared between the black eyelids.
Directly at Lian.
Boom!
The entire black network under the hall lit up.
Hundreds of kilometers away, the bones planted inside the wolves’ necks responded at the same time.
A notification appeared in front of Lian.
[Pack Network activated.]
[Awakening of Wolf of Eight Disaster has begun.]
The other seven eyes were still closed but even that one eye was enough to make the pressure inside the hall several times stronger.
The young Vorhelm did not take his eyes away from the golden eye and the corner of his lips slowly rose.
"I knew taking a treasure was never going to be easy, but come on, seriously?"

sentences.text: After that, he took his eyes away from the notifications, the wolves behind him were getting closer and he did not want to waste any more time.
He passed through the gate and at that exact moment, something strange happened.
The wolf monsters stopped.
He took a few more steps but there was truly no longer any sound of claws, he turned his head and saw dozens of wolves standing right behind the entrance of the fortress.
They showed their teeth, growled, and some had even lowered their bodies and it was clear that they wanted to attack.
But none of them stepped inside, not even the Gravehowl wolves.
The young Vorhelm looked at them for a few seconds, the pressure of his Fallen Talent was not the reason for this behavior, this fear came from somewhere else.
Whatever the reason was, it was behind him, inside the fortress, whatever was inside was so terrifying to these monsters that they did not dare to enter its territory because of their fear.
He slowly turned around and looked more carefully, he was still not sure whether there was an Unholy inside or not, but whatever it was, it was definitely not weak.
The inside of the fortress was much larger than what it looked like from outside.
The ceiling of the hall was almost fifty meters high.
Eight huge pillars stretched from the floor to the ceiling and on each one, there were worn carvings of a creature with eight eyes and eight arms.
Divine of Chaos.
But something had polluted these old remains, wolf bones were hanging from the walls and skulls were placed inside the cracks of the pillars.
Some spiral symbols had been scratched by claws and in the middle of the hall, a huge circle had been carved into the floor.
Eight stone paths reached it from eight different directions.
Lian raised his head, from inside the ceiling, the lower part of the same huge crown could be seen, the distance was much smaller now.
Black strands came down from the structure of the crown, a network of dark lines had entered the stone.
He activated True Sequence and the paths became clear.
The crown, the pillars, the eight paths, the central circle and then the strands connected to them all went down, underground and toward one point.
Whatever it was, it was down there.
The Heavenly Book of Treasures reacted inside the storage space, before Lian could even take it out...Boom!
The entire hall shook.
The same pulse, but this time it was so close that it entered directly into his bones from the floor.
A few pieces of dust fell from the ceiling and then a sound came from underground.
Breathing.
The sound of long, deep and heavy breathing.
"Hــــــــــــــah..."
His hunter instincts activated immediately but what they sent him was different from the warning given by the monsters outside.
It was as if they were warning him that whatever was there, it was a great hunter.
He looked toward the end of the hall, behind two broken pillars, a huge staircase went down.
He stood there for a few seconds and then moved, in any case, he did not care and was not that worried, he had seen things that had made him somewhat numb to almost anything.
With every step he went down, the pressure became stronger, the air was also heavy and the smell of a beast could be felt from it.
The walls of the stairs were covered with black chains and on every ring, the spiral symbol of the Divine of Chaos could be seen.
The farther down he went, the thicker the chains became.
Finally, the stairs ended.
Lian entered a hall that was even larger than the upper hall and stopped there.
Something was sleeping in the darkness, at first he only saw its size.
And then [Night Eyes] made the details clearer.
Its body was almost fifteen meters long.
It was a wolf.
But if someone used only this word to describe it, almost all of the truth would be lost.
The creature’s fur had probably once been black, but now it had changed between burned gray and dead black.
Parts of the skin on its sides and chest were completely missing and something like bone armor was coming out from under the flesh.
Its ribs were far too long.
Some of them had passed through the skin and grown like curved horns along its sides.
Each of its front claws was almost the size of a human body and its black nails had sunk several centimeters into the stone even while it was sleeping.
But the head was the worst part, it had a huge and long skull, its mouth was closed, but even in that state, two rows of teeth were sticking out from between its rotten lips.
Not one row, like every other normal creature, but two rows, as if another jaw had grown inside the first jaw.
And there were eight eyes on its face, four eyes on each side and four eyes on the other side and all of them were closed.
Eight long bone blades came out from the back of its head and were placed around its skull like an uneven crown.
But unlike the crown of normal wolves, these did not look natural.
On each blade, thin lines similar to the same Divine of Chaos spirals had been carved.
Huge black chains were wrapped around the creature’s neck, legs, chest and spine.
Some had passed directly through its bones.
Several chains had even entered its flesh and come out from the other side.
It was as if someone had imprisoned this creature.
No ...
This creature had not only been sealed, they had wanted to make sure that even if it tore apart all of its flesh, it still could not escape.
Black veins came out from its spine and entered the floor of the hall.
Lian followed their path with True Sequence, this was the network!
The same thing that was connected to the black bones behind the necks of all the Gravehowl wolves ...the source of the command was here.
The System finally showed its information.
[Wolf Of Eight Disaster.]
[Rank: Fallen ( Unholy ) ]
[Level: 40.]
Lian looked at the panel for a few seconds.
Level forty.
The level difference was sixteen.
And something about this creature’s appearance said that even among Fallen monsters, it was probably not normal.
And the Unholy written in parentheses explained by itself that this creature was definitely different from every Fallen he had seen.
His eyes moved over the chains.
The symbols of the Divine of Chaos.
This was more important than the level, this wolf had not been worshiped by the followers of the Divine of Chaos, it had been imprisoned.
The civilization that had once built the Sanctuary of the Eightfold Paths had buried this thing under the city with chains that were still active after all these years.
But the civilization had been destroyed, although the prison remained and the imprisoned creature had connected all the wolves in the area to itself from inside that same prison.
Instead of escaping, it had built a territory for itself.
Then the young Vorhelm raised his head slightly, another mana strand went directly from Eightfold Fang’s body to the ceiling.
To the crown.
He took out the Celestial Book of Treasures and the pages immediately opened.
[A treasure is located nearby.]
[Final examination requires direct contact with the crown.]
He also activated the World Memory, hoping to see whether he could obtain information with the help of this artifact and the map.
World Memory could practically bring the map to life and add old and historical details to it.
In the end, part of the worn information was recovered.
[Historical structure identified.]
[Eightfold Containment System.]
[The crown is part of the containment structure.]
His eyes narrowed slightly, so the problem was clear, the treasure he had come here for was probably the same thing that was keeping this creature here.
If he took the crown... the chains might stop working.

chapters.title: Chapter 489: The Wold Of Eight Disasters II
paragraphs: "I knew taking a treasure was never going to be easy, but seriously?" Lian said without taking his eyes away from the opened golden eye.
The other seven eyes were still closed.
The Wolf of Eight Disasters was still lying on the floor of the hall, but simply opening that one eye was enough to make the pressure in the area several times stronger.
Dust was rising through the cracks in the stone and the black chains around its huge body were shaking with a quiet sound.
Even so, it was still imprisoned.
Chains as thick as tree trunks passed through its neck, chest, legs, and spine, keeping that fifteen-meter body inside a certain area.
Which meant that until it was fully awake, he had a few seconds.
And for someone like him, a few seconds was not a short amount of time.
He opened his own panel.
[Name: Lian Vorhelm.]
[Level: 24.]
[Strength: 1800.]
[Spirit: 1100.]
[Resistance: 1200.]
[Stats Points: 4709.]
Lian kept his eyes on the last number for a moment.
Four thousand seven hundred and nine points.
And a level forty monster was standing in front of him.
Not just a Fallen monster, but something that also had Unholy written in parentheses in front of it, he had some guesses about why it was like this but he was not sure.
His best guess was that this creature had once been a true Unholy, but it was no longer like that and it could have something to do with that crown.
Whatever the case, he had no interest in taking a risk.
Lian made his choices.
[Resistance: 1200 → 2000.]
[4709 stats points consumed.]
[Free stats points remaining: 0.]
[Total Stats: 11,653.]
A strong heat spread from the center of his body.
For a few moments, all of his muscles tightened. His bones became heavier, his heartbeat became stronger and the flow of mana moved through the inner paths of his body several times faster.
But the thing he immediately felt was speed.
Doubling his base speed was not something that could be ignored.
Even the simple movement of his fingers had become lighter and the information his eyes received seemed to reach his brain with less delay.
And more interestingly, his total stats had gone above 10,000, he had guessed that his limit was not 10,000 and now he was sure.
Although he was not that surprised, even though he had monster-like stats for someone who had not even reached the second evolution yet, compared to the later evolutions, it was like a joke.
Someone who had passed the third evolution had a stat limit of 300,000 stats, compared to such power, he was like a joke.
The wolf’s golden eye narrowed and Lian noticed it.
The creature in front of him did not speak, but this small reaction was enough.
Even that monster had understood that the human standing in front of it a few seconds ago was no longer exactly the same human.
"Much better now."
He opened and closed his right fist.
At the same moment ...Boom!
The black network under the hall lit up and the first eye of the Wolf of Eight Disasters flashed for a moment.
A System notification appeared.
[Eight Disasters]
[Each eye carries one independent disaster transformation.]
[Active Disaster: 1/8.]
[First Disaster — Feast of the Dead.]
A strange sound came from under the floor, something similar to liquid flowing through thousands of pipes.
The young Vorhelm looked down.
[True Sequence]
The hidden paths under the stone became visible one after another.
Hundreds of strands.
Thousands of branches.
Some of them were kilometers away from this hall and at the end of many of them, there were corpses.
Huge piles of dead bodies had been stored in rooms, wells, and underground tunnels.
Humans.
Wolves.
Monsters.
Some were fresh and some were so old that only bones remained, but even those were not useless.
The black network passed through them and the remaining mana, blood, bone marrow, broken cores and anything else that could be used were extracted.
And all the paths ended in this hall and the black veins coming out of the wolf’s spine lit up.
The energy entered its body like a river flowing in reverse and the chain around the creature’s right leg moved.
Crack!
A thin crack appeared on the huge ring.
"So you were not collecting them for food." Lian stayed silent for a moment and then understood, all these were the corpses that the subordinates of this monster had collected for it.
The golden eye remained on him and the flow of energy became stronger.
"You were eating your prison with them." He kept his eyes on the cracked chain.
[Energy stored for complete freedom is insufficient.]
[Containment System Erosion: 43%.]
Forty-three percent was not enough to completely free that creature but it was completely enough for what happened next.
The wolf’s huge muscles tightened and one of its front claws slowly lifted from the ground and the chains were pulled.
Kaaaaang!
The floor of the hall broke under its claw.
Lian still did not move.
The wolf raised its head slightly and at that moment the second eye opened and a red pupil shone in the darkness.
[Second Disaster activated.]
[Blood Hunt Moon.]
The hall became red for a moment.
A black-red circle formed above the monster’s head, not a real moon, but a ring of concentrated mana that cast a blood-like light over the stones.
Then the wolf’s body changed, the muscles of its legs became longer, its rear joints changed their angle slightly, its claws became thinner and longer.
The young Vorhelm understood only one thing, speed, far too much speed, the speed of that thing was still impossible for him to understand.
The wolf disappeared from in front of his eyes!
Predator’s Instincts reacted before his eyes.
Left.
Lian raised his forearm.
Kaaaaang!
The black claw landed on the World-Devourer Bastion but the force of the impact pushed his body back more than ten meters.
His heels created two deep lines in the stone and his eyes narrowed slightly.
The wolf moved again and this time he saw its first path.
Forward.
The huge body came from the right and Lian prepared to block the attack but the monster stopped for a fraction of a second, a very small and unusual stop and then the second claw came up from below.
He only noticed the trick at the last moment and turned his body at full speed.
Sherrrk!
Three deep lines appeared across the chest plate of the armor.
If he had reacted one tenth of a second later, the attack would have landed directly in the middle of his chest.
Lian took two steps back.
The wolf prepared again and this time the same stop happened again.
"I understand." The young Vorhelm whispered.
The third movement began, the wolf jumped forward, stopped for a moment but this time when the real attack changed direction...its target was no longer there.
[Thunder Step]
Boom!
His body appeared beside the wolf’s neck.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
A huge ice arc landed on the dark skin.
Shrrrrk!
Black blood splashed into the air and a deep wound appeared on the neck and the monster violently turned its head, its jaws closed but it was clear that it had become angry.
Lian moved back and at that exact moment two teeth passed only a few centimeters beside his face.
He barely dodged, if he had made the smallest mistake, it would have become the last mistake of his life.
That damn thing was too fast, so fast that it made no sense, how could it move this fast with that huge body?
Fortunately, his eyes could now follow its movements to some extent.
But at that moment the third eye opened.
[Third Disaster — Bone Mountain.]
The wolf made no sound, it simply slammed its front claw onto the ground.
Boooooom!
The floor of the hall cracked and the first bone pillar came out beside Lian’s foot.
Then the second.
The third ...
The tenth.
In less than three seconds, hundreds of huge bones grew from the ground, some as thick as a human body and some several meters wide.
The large hall turned into a white and black forest of bones.
At the same time, the wolf’s own body also changed, bone plates came out from its shoulders and longer ribs locked into place along its sides, the eight blades behind its skull became thicker.
Lian closed the distance and his fist, together with Thunder Calamity, struck the creature’s shoulder.
Kaaaabooooom!
Lightning spread through the entire bone armor but when the dust cleared, only a few cracks could be seen.
He slowly lowered his arm and a frown appeared on his face.
His direct attack had no effect, with this situation, he had to find its weak point.
[True Sequence]
The structure of the body in front of his mind opened, the plates were not thick but layered, they spread the impact between themselves, but there was a thin gap between every two layers.
And he saw it.
Lian opened his hand.
[Frost Dominion]
The cold did not pass through the surface of the armor but entered through the gaps, ice grew in the space between the plates.
The wolf noticed and moved its body ...but it was too late and the young Vorhelm closed his fingers.
[Thunder Calamity]
Krrrrrrrr!
Lightning entered the ice, this time it did not hit the armor from outside but was inside the structure and spread through it.
Booooom!
Three huge plates on the wolf’s shoulder exploded from the inside, pieces of bone flew through the air.
Lian moved through them and his elbow struck the same opened area.
Crack!
The wolf’s body was pushed several meters to the side for the first time, its eyes shone with even more anger as if it had realized that it was no longer facing an ordinary prey.
The fourth eye opened.
Predator’s Instincts screamed almost at the same moment.
Bad.
Lian understood even before seeing the notification.
Very bad.
[Fourth Disaster — Skyless Howl.]
The wolf raised its head and all the air in the hall was pulled toward its mouth.
Dust, pieces of bone, even the cold mist of Frost Dominion, everything was pulled toward its mouth.
He immediately activated Mountain Anchor and the armored feet locked onto the ground.
One second.
Two seconds.
Then—
Awooooooooooooooooo—!!!
The world shook.
This was no longer a howl, a huge sound wall came out of the wolf’s mouth ...

chapters.title: Chapter 490: The Wolf Of Eight Disasters III
paragraphs: The first pillar turned into ash.
The second pillar broke from the middle.
The ice Lian had created turned into powder before the wave could hit it directly.
The wave arrived.
BOOOOOOM!
Mountain Frame spread the force through the entire armor and Mountain Anchor forced it into the ground.
But it was not enough.
His body was dragged several dozen meters backward along with a piece of the floor, his armor made loud sounds and his ears could not hear anything for a moment.
A warm line ran down from the side of his neck.
Blood.
When the howl ended, the hall no longer looked like it had a few seconds ago, half of the pillars were damaged and cracks had spread across the ceiling stones.
Lian slowly straightened his head, there was a strong ringing sound inside his ears but he was still standing.
Although lines of blood were flowing from his eyes and ears, and the condition of both his vision and hearing was not good.
The wolf stared at him, as if it was still surprised by how this human had managed to survive.
It had used four of its eyes, but even then it still had not defeated its prey, this was rare.
Most of the creatures it had faced could not even endure three of its eyes and now one had managed to continue until the fifth.
Its fifth eye opened.
[The Fifth Disaster — Bodiless Pack.]
The wolf’s shadow moved, then the shadows of the pillars, and then the shadows of the corpses.
Lian frowned slightly.
The first shape rose from the ground, a black wolf, without flesh, without skin, and with a body made from dark mana and something that looked like the remains of a will.
The second.
The fifth.
The tenth.
Very soon, dozens of black creatures appeared throughout the hall.
One of them was a wolf whose head he had cut off a few hours ago, the wound on its neck could still be seen even on its black body.
The young Vorhelm looked at it for a moment, he did not even know how he should react.
The pack attacked.
False Presence.
A presence of him appeared in a different direction and caused part of the pack to immediately change direction.
Lian also immediately placed his hand on the ground to use the chance that had appeared.
[Frost Dominion]
This time, instead of targeting the open area, he targeted the corridor.
Thin ice walls rose from the ground and divided the black pack into smaller groups.
[Cataclysm Pulse]
BOOOOOOM!
Six black creatures broke apart at the same time, but their bodies turned into smoke and a few seconds later they took shape again.
"So killing you is useless."
The teeth of one of the mana wolves passed beside his arm.
Lian moved backward and at that exact moment, Predator’s Instincts gave him a warning.
The main wolf came out from behind the pack and its huge claw landed directly on his chest.
KABOOOOOM!
Three plates on the front of his armor cracked and his body was thrown dozens of meters away, he passed through an ice wall and crashed into a stone pillar.
His breath stopped for a moment and he landed on one knee, a sharp pain was in his chest.
He even felt like his breath was trapped inside his chest and he could not breathe properly, and the passages were blocked.
"Cough! Cough!"
He took out a small bottle from his storage space, broke the cap with his finger and drank it in one breath.
Warmth spread through his body and his injuries were partly healed.
Lian stood up but this time he was no longer only looking at the monster, he was looking at the chains.
Every time one of the eyes had opened, the flow of one of the main chains had changed and with one look, he realized that there were also eight chains.
Eight eyes.
Eight disasters.
Eight chains.
Eight paths.
Lian’s eyes narrowed.
"So the name Eight Paths Sanctuary was not only because of its architecture."
The followers of the Divine Of Chaos had not restrained this creature with only one prison.

They had sealed each disaster separately, each eye was one path and each path was one chain and every time the monster opened one of the paths to use a specific disaster, it created a gate inside its prison for a moment.
But he became a little curious, who had been able to imprison this monster at its peak? And was this monster related to the Divine Of Chaos? Because all the signs were showing something like that.
This information might be useful later but there were still three eyes left that he had to deal with.
The sixth eye opened.
[The Sixth Disaster — Reversed Maw.]
The wolf opened its mouth.
Lian prepared for a howl or a wave of mana but nothing came out and instead ...space bent.
He took one step backward but his body was pulled two meters toward the wolf.
"Damn it." He frowned and immediately activated Thunder Step, his target was to escape toward the left.
BOOM!
But his body appeared on the right side!
"Hmm?"
The wolf moved and the young Vorhelm immediately jumped backward, although to his surprise, the distance suddenly became smaller.
After guessing something, he moved forward and to his surprise, the distance became larger.
"So that’s how it is, huh?" For a few seconds, all the rules of distance had been reversed.
But before he could decide his next target, two huge shadows appeared above and below the hall.
A maw.
It did not belong to the monster, but it was as if space itself had taken the shape of jaws, the upper edge came down and the lower one rose up.
Lian activated True Sequence to its highest level.
Thousands of broken paths, reversed directions, but one small point on the right side of the hall remained stable, the flow of space was not twisted there.
He moved without thinking.
[Ash Step]
His body turned into a gray mass and at the same time the jaws closed.
KABOOOOOOOOOM!
Half of the hall was crushed, the pillars broke and the stones shattered.
He took shape again just outside the range and for a moment looked at the huge hole where he had been standing a few seconds ago.
If he had realized it any later, even with World-Devourer Bastion, he probably would not have come out of that alive.
And the monster roared, as if its anger had reached its highest point because this human was still alive.
The seventh eye opened.
[The Seventh Disaster — Inverted Day.]
Lian did not feel anything at first, but suddenly his entire body left the ground.
It was not a jump or floating, more accurately, he was falling toward the ceiling!
Rocks, bones, remains of pillars, corpses and even the Wolf Of Eight Disasters all fell upward.
He turned his body in the air and the wolf’s claws reached the wall, unlike him, the creature immediately adapted itself to the new situation.
It started running on the ceiling and was coming toward him and suddenly it struck its claw toward its target.
[Thunder Step]
Lian escaped the first claw and the second came from the side, he turned his body and the claw passed a few centimeters from his face.
Then gravity changed again...everything fell downward!
BOOOOOOOOOOM!
The ground shook under the weight of thousands of tons of stone and bones, cracks spread across the ceiling and the wolf reversed gravity again.
The ceiling, which was already damaged, could not hold and part of it collapsed.
The sixth chain was pulled and the seventh chain was also put under pressure.
CRACK!
One of the links broke.
For the first time, the wolf was able to move its body several meters beyond its previous range.
Then it jumped straight upward and its fifteen-meter body passed through the ceiling of the underground area.
KAAAAAAAAABOOOOOOOOOM!
The floor of the upper hall exploded and the huge pillars collapsed as the monster came up through the fortress.
Lian also followed it through the opening with Thunder Step and the battle left the underground area.
Cold air and mist hit the young Vorhelm’s face again but the scene in front of him was almost impossible to recognize.
A large part of the central fortress had collapsed, the main tower was cracked and the walls were broken.
The Wolf Of Eight Disasters stood on the remains of one of the towers and its seven opened eyes were shining through the mist like seven ominous lights.
All the wolves around the fortress had moved back, some had fallen on their stomachs and some were running away.
None of them approached the master who had commanded them through the network for years.
Now Lian could see the network more clearly.
The wells, corpse storage areas and black veins under the ground, different generations of wolves had collected corpses over the years.
To free this monster.
The biological materials from the corpses entered the network and the Wolf Of Eight Disasters used them to somehow try to destroy the chains.
He had no idea how this monster was doing it, he did not even know what those chains were, but whatever it was, it seemed to be succeeding.
The chains had successfully been weakened and now this creature’s movement range covered almost the entire central fortress.
But the crown was still active and black strands from the huge structure above the remaining tower were still connected to the wolf’s body.
The final restraint.
This creature could destroy the fortress, but it still could not leave The Wolfgrave Fortresses.
At least for now, until the crown stopped working, this monster could not completely break free and Lian’s presence was causing everything to go wrong.
And the Wolf Of Eight Disasters did not like this, it would not allow anyone to ruin its freedom.
Its last eye finally opened...

chapters.title: Chapter 491: The Second Special Colony Member
paragraphs: All eight eyes lit up, for a moment nothing happened but then a Blood Moon appeared behind the wolf.
Bones grew on its body and the shadows of the pack formed around it.

Space twisted and the stones moved against gravity for a moment, the air gathered for another howl and all seven previous disasters appeared at the same time, weaker than their independent forms but together.
[Warning.]
[The eight disasters have connected to each other.]
[The Unholy structure is activating.]
The pressure of the wolf went beyond what a Fallen monster should have for a moment.
Lian looked at it without moving for a few seconds and then slowly let out a breath.
"We have finally reached the hard part."
The wolf howled.
[Eternal Frozen Apocalypse]
KRRRRRRRRRRRK!
The entire battlefield froze within a few seconds, ice towers grew from the ruins and the mist turned into small crystals.
The ice covered everything within one second and completely removed the environmental advantage of the Wolf Of Eight Disasters.
The disasters that changed the environment lost part of their power and the shadow pack was also weakened.
The ground under the wolf was covered with several meters of ice and [Thunder Disaster] exploded around Lian’s body.
Blue-purple lightning moved across World-Devourer Bastion.
The monster attacked and the young Vorhelm did the same and the two creatures met in the middle of the white battlefield.
BOOOOOOM!
The shockwave of the collision destroyed the remaining part of the wall, Lian moved backward and the wolf was also dragged several meters across the ice.
But a direct battle was not the way to win, he was sure of this now.
Eight eyes, eight paths and every time the monster activated a disaster, the chain of that path opened for a moment.
Those chains could become his path to victory, so all he needed to do was force the monster to make the same mistake eight times.
A small smile appeared and he intentionally increased the distance.
The wolf chased him.
[Thunder Step]
To make sure he would not fall into the wolf’s hands, he increased the distance at his highest speed.
The monster responded by activating the Blood Hunt Moon, exactly what he wanted.
The second eye lit up and the related chain opened for a moment and [True Sequence] saw the path.
Lian placed his hand on the ground.
[Thunder Disaster]
But his target was not the wolf itself, instead he directly targeted inside the path of the chain.
KRRRRR!
The reverse current entered the eye and for the first time, the monster made a short painful sound.
The second eye closed and the Blood Moon disappeared.
The lightning passed through the chain and completely disabled the eye and the huge monster screamed and behind it came a roar of anger.
[The second path has been disrupted.]
Lian moved backward.
The wolf became angry.
And the third eye activated [Bone Mountain] and bones began to grow.
He allowed the bones to continue growing and when the third path opened, he made his attack.
[Frost Dominion]
The cold entered the same chain and moved from the chain into the eye, behind it the lightning also moved and entered the monster’s third eye.
CRACK!
The third eye closed.
The wolf now understood that something was wrong, but it still did not know what.
[Skyless Howl]
The young Vorhelm prepared himself and the sound wave came, this time he did not only defend but at the moment the fourth path opened...
[Suppressing Palm]
The palm struck the chain itself.
BOOOOOOM!
To make sure he could test the target, he sacrificed a very large amount of mana and just as he thought, the path broke.
The fourth eye went dark.
Bodiless Pack.
Reversed Maw.
Inverted Day.
Every time the wolf activated one of its greatest powers and every time Lian cut part of the network connected to that power.
The opening of the eyes was the same as activating the disasters and all he had to do was make sure those eyes did not open.
The eyes went dark one after another.
Seven.
Six.
Five.
Four.
In the end, only two eyes remained, the first eye and finally, the eighth eye.
The wolf finally understood, it understood what this human was doing and it did not activate any more disasters.
"Finally understood?"
The monster attacked directly without any other change, even if it could not activate its disasters, its own power was not something that could be underestimated.
And this might be more dangerous than all the disasters.
The claw came down and Lian raised his forearm.
KAAAAAAABOOOOOM!
Three plates of World-Devourer Bastion broke and his body went into the half-destroyed wall like a bullet ...stones fell on him.
The wolf did not wait and attacked again with a direct jump.
The young Vorhelm immediately took out a potion bottle and opened it with his teeth, he drank half of it.
Then, feeling the danger coming toward him at high speed, he activated [Ash Step] without hesitation.
The wolf’s claw destroyed the wall.
Lian appeared behind it, just as the monster could attack, he could also counterattack.
[Iron Fortress Charge]
The wolf turned and the two creatures collided directly.
BOOOOOOOOOOOM!
As a result, Lian moved backward, the pure power of the monster was much stronger.
One meter.
Three meters.
Five meters.
But he did not fall.
[Mountain Anchor] The ground under his feet sank and the wolf’s power was spread through the armor.
He took one step forward and the monster paused for a moment, it probably did not expect the small creature in front of it to still be standing after a direct collision.
Lian placed his right palm under the monster’s jaw.
"My turn." If he could not gain the advantage in direct collisions, then he would attack from a distance.
[Suppressing Palm]
KAAAAABOOOOOM!
The attack was released at zero distance and the head of the fifteen-meter wolf was violently thrown upward, several teeth spun through the air and one of the blades of its bone crown cracked.
The young Vorhelm immediately activated [Thunder Step] and went up.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
SHRRRRRK!
One of the crown blades was separated from its base and the wolf howled in pain, it could no longer open it and its eighth eye lit up.
The Eighth Disaster was about to activate again.
And Lian had been waiting for this and at that exact moment a claw came toward him.
[Ash Step]
His body passed through the attack and feeling that it was time to weaken the monster even more, poison began to leak from his body.
[Bloodborn Disaster Dominion]
The destructive poison spread across the entire area and since there was no other target except the Wolf Of Eight Disasters, all the poison flowed toward it.
As the poison entered its body’s veins, it howled in pain again, its health was rapidly decreasing.
The monster barely turned its head but Lian was already in front of it and all the mana was compressed inside his real palm and his palm was placed on the wolf’s forehead.
"Sleep." He said calmly.
[Suppressing Palm]
Boom.
The sound of the impact was strange, small and almost disappointing, as if nothing had happened.
But a moment later, a wave of pressure was released from inside its skull and the wolf’s eyes opened at the same time.
Its body became completely stiff and all its organs and vital systems stopped for a moment.
Its legs bent and the fifteen-meter body fell to the ground.
BOOOOOOM!
Snow, stones and dust flew into the air.
Lian landed several meters away and did not move for a few seconds, his condition was also not good.
His breathing had become heavy, part of his armor was broken, although it was already rebuilding itself and his body was also in pain.
But he was standing.
The wolf was still alive but it could no longer fight.
The System notification appeared.
[A Pack Sovereign has been defeated.]
[The target’s resistance will is collapsing.]
[The Colony Sovereign talent has reacted.]
He kept his eyes on the notification.
[The target is suitable to be registered as a Special Colony Member.]
[Current Special Members: 1/5.]
[Add the target to the Colony?]
Lian looked at the huge wolf.
A fifteen-meter creature that had been destroying half of the fortress with every movement only a few minutes ago.
A calm smile appeared on his face.
[Yes.]
Threads of Colony light appeared around the wolf’s body, the monster resisted for a moment and its muscles moved.
Its first eye opened halfway, but the battle was over and the threads entered its body, it no longer had the will to continue.
It had been defeated and humiliated in the worst possible way by a human.
But it still had its own pride and it did not want to surrender!
However, as soon as the connection between them was formed, it seemed to notice something, as if it had felt something deep inside this human.
And finally, a few seconds later, its huge head slowly lowered.
[Registration process completed.]
[New Special Colony Member added.]
[Please determine the member’s name.]
Lian looked at the panel for a few seconds, he did not need much time to think, he was confident that his naming skill was among the best.
"Two."
[Name registered.]
[Two.]
[Special Colony Members: 2/5.]
The Wolf Of Eight Disasters, or the creature that from this moment onward was simply Two to Lian, closed its eye again.

Lian looked at the huge wolf.
A fifteen-meter creature that had been destroying half of the fortress with every movement only a few minutes ago.
A calm smile appeared on his face.
[Yes.]
Threads of Colony light appeared around the wolf’s body, the monster resisted for a moment and its muscles moved.
Its first eye opened halfway, but the battle was over and the threads entered its body, it no longer had the will to continue.
It had been defeated and humiliated in the worst possible way by a human.
But it still had its own pride and it did not want to surrender!
However, as soon as the connection between them was formed, it seemed to notice something, as if it had felt something deep inside this human.
And finally, a few seconds later, its huge head slowly lowered.
[Registration process completed.]
[New Special Colony Member added.]
[Please determine the member’s name.]
Lian looked at the panel for a few seconds, he did not need much time to think, he was confident that his naming skill was among the best.
"Two."
[Name registered.]
[Two.]
[Special Colony Members: 2/5.]
The Wolf Of Eight Disasters, or the creature that from this moment onward was simply Two to Lian, closed its eye again.

chapters.title: Chapter 492: End Of Hunt
paragraphs: Lian looked at the place where the huge monster was standing for a few moments.
Until a few minutes ago, every movement it made could destroy part of the fortress.
Now it was his second Special Colony Member.
But before he could think about this any further, something else happened throughout The Wolfgrave Fortresses.
Thum...
The last pulse of the pack network passed through the underground and then went silent.
The black bones behind the necks of hundreds of wolves lost their light one after another.

A Wolfgrave Howler that was still standing on the ruins of one of the walls suddenly moved its body and looked around in confusion for a moment, as if something that had whispered in its ear for its entire life had suddenly disappeared.
Another wolf had the same reaction.
Then the third.
Within a few seconds, chaos spread among all the packs.
The permanent command that had connected them to one network for generations no longer existed.
Several wolves looked toward the central fortress and then one of them fixed its eyes on Lian, its ears lowered.
One step backward.
Then a second step.
This time there was no command to suppress its instinct, the instinctive fear they felt toward this human entered them again.
Lian’s pressure fell over the ordinary monsters like something invisible.
A wolf that had been ready to fight until its last breath for its master only a few minutes ago now lowered its tail and turned around.
It started running.
Another one followed it.
Then five wolves.
Ten wolves.
In less than a few seconds, panic spread among the packs, some jumped down from the walls and some ran away through the old roads.
Several groups even crashed into each other while trying to escape.
The young Vorhelm looked at them from the top of a high ruin and a very small smile appeared on his face.
"Now you remembered that you should be afraid?" he said calmly.
Then he disappeared.
A group of nearly fifteen wolves was escaping through one of the stone bridges toward the forest.
The front wolf had just stepped onto the other half of the bridge when... BOOM!
Lightning exploded at the end of the path and Lian appeared directly in front of them.
[Thunder Step.]
The entire group stopped at the same time and their claws scratched against the stone, one of the wolves immediately changed its direction and ran toward the edge of the bridge.
The young Vorhelm did not even turn his head toward it and his left hand rose slightly.
[Grave Fang.]
Two huge mana jaws formed on both sides of the wolf’s body.
Crack!
They closed at the same time, the sound of bones breaking came and the monster’s body fell from the wall.
The other wolves did not attack and ran away directly, but the ground under their feet turned white.
[Frost Dominion.]
Ice spread across the stones at an incredible speed and the feet of several wolves slipped on the surface.
Lian took one step forward.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
A blue arc formed in the air.
SHRRRRRK!
Three bodies were split almost at the same time and blood splashed across the frozen bridge, one of the Level 34 wolves jumped from the wall in fear.
He only gave it a short look.
[Thunder Step]
A moment later he was above it and his foot came down.
Boom!
The wolf crashed into the ground at several times its normal falling speed and the stone under its body broke.
After the battle with Two, these monsters no longer created the same pressure as before, the difference in power was too great and now the packs had even lost their coordination.
Twenty more wolves fell one after another, some tried to fight, some only ran away.
The result was not very different.
[6 Fragments obtained.]
[6 Fragments obtained.]
[6 Fragments obtained.]
After the twentieth wolf died, another notification replaced the usual reward.
[The condition for Trait Evolution has been completed.]
[The Wolf Slayer title has reached the required amount of Wolf-based creatures hunted.]
[The evolution process has begun.]
[Wolfbane]
[Basic reward for killing each ordinary Wolf-based creature: 5 Fragments.]
Lian raised an eyebrow.
Then another notification appeared.
[The Wolfgrave Fortresses Regional Trait is active.]
[Trait efficiency: 300%.]
[Current reward for killing each ordinary Wolf-based creature in this area: 15 Fragments.]
Lian looked at the number fifteen for a few seconds.
[Previous Fragments: 361]
[Fragments obtained: 120.]
[Current Fragments: 481.]
He raised his head, in the distance, many wolves were still running between the fortresses.
A calm smile appeared on his face.
"You made a mistake by not running away sooner."
The hunt continued.
The wolves closer to the central fortress were usually stronger.
One of them, a thin and tall monster at Level 35, did not run toward the forest but escaped through the ruined houses.
Lian followed it for several minutes, the monster kept changing its path, jumping through windows, running across walls and even using narrow alleys to break his line of sight.
It was a real hunter but its problem was that the one chasing it was a better hunter.
The wolf jumped from the top of a broken wall, it had not reached the ground yet when the hunter appeared in front of it.
The monster’s eyes became wider for a moment.
"Found you."
His fist hit directly into its chest.
Boom!
The body fell into the ruins.
Glutton reacted.
[Extraction options identified.]
[Hunter’s Scent]
[Hunter’s Step]
[Chain Hunt.]
He opened the last option.
[Chain Hunt.]
[After killing a hostile creature, the closest enemy within the effect range is marked as the next target for a short time.]
[The user’s movement speed increases while approaching the marked target.]
[If the target is killed before the effect ends, the mark is transferred to the next target.]
[The effect can stack up to three stages.]
[Speed increase at the third stage: 60% maximum.]
He read the explanation for a few moments and then looked at the wolves escaping in the distance.
[Chain Hunt obtained.]
Almost immediately, a faint point appeared in his senses, a wolf was several hundred meters away.
[Next target identified.]
Lian moved, his speed suddenly became even higher and less than a few seconds later he reached the target.
The wolf had not even noticed his presence when an ice claw passed through the back of its neck.
[Next target identified.]
Second target.
He moved again and before long the third target fell and the effect reached the third stage.
From that moment onward, the thing moving through the ruins looked less like a human and more like a line of lightning, ice and blood.
For nearly one hour, The Wolfgrave Fortresses became Lian’s hunting ground.
But there was no longer anything like the first battle, the packs had collapsed, some were escaping in small groups, some entered the forest alone and some even used the old paths.
Lian also was not going to chase the last wolf in the area.
The farther the distance from the central fortress became, the more scattered the targets became and the more time it took to chase them.
A considerable number of them managed to escape.
More than a hundred wolves spread throughout the forests, plains and unknown parts of the borders of The Wolfgrave Fortresses.
But more of them did not have the same chance.
When the young Vorhelm finally stopped, the clothes under his armor were wet with sweat and hundreds of corpses were lying in different parts of the ruins.
The final panel appeared.
[Number of Wolf-based creatures killed after obtaining the Wolfbane title: 112.]
[Fragments obtained : 1680.]
[Current Fragments: 2161.]
Lian kept his eyes on the number for a few seconds.
Two thousand one hundred and sixty-one Fragments.
He could now upgrade some of his Traits and he could also use the Skill Fusion section.
But this was not the only reward from the hunt and a faint blue light appeared around his body.
[Required experience completed.]
[Level increased.]
[Level increased.]
[200 stats points obtained.]
He slowly let out a breath.
Level twenty-six.
He had come to hunt a few monsters to increase his power a little, the result had gone slightly beyond what he expected.
But it was not as if he was unhappy, in fact, this hunt could be considered his greatest hunt and the reward and profit he had gained from this hunt were incredible.
With this situation, he might really be able to reach the second evolution within the next three months and before entering the Land Of First Dawn.
Besides all of this, he had obtained Two, a creature that, apart from its own terrifying power, could also control other packs of wolf-type monsters.
When he returned to the central fortress, the area around him looked more like a massacre ground than a fortress, wolves were lying in every corner.
Some of the corpses were from the previous battles and some were the result of the hunt during the last hour.
And this meant there were a lot of cores to absorb and because of this, he had to summon One.

chapters.title: Chapter 493: Crown of Eight Paths
paragraphs: He activated the Colony Link.
[Special Colony Member selected.]
[One.]
[Summoning.]
Particles of light gathered in front of him and One landed on the ground, as soon as it appeared, its antennae remained completely still for a moment.
Lian noticed it, One was no longer the only member of his Colony and the giant ant had noticed this.
Besides that, there was a huge presence behind them which was his new Colony Member.
Two.
One turned its head toward its master, the feeling of a question through the link was almost clear enough that there was no need for words.
What is that?
Lian looked at it.
"I’ll explain later."
"For now, you should absorb the cores." He then pointed toward the hundreds of corpses.
One’s focus changed almost immediately, its antennae rose and a few seconds later it moved among the corpses and carefully took out the remaining cores.
One core.
Three cores.
Ten cores.
Many of the stronger wolves had suitable cores and the giant ant immediately started absorbing them.
[Multiple monster cores have been absorbed.]
[The First Evolution Saturation process has progressed greatly.]
[Saturation status: High.]
[The evolution condition has not been completed yet.]
"At this rate, I guess it shouldn’t take too long." The young Vorhelm looked at the notification, but it was still surprising that even all these cores were not enough.
In any case, he still had something else that he needed to deal with.
The Wolfcrown Fortress had lost a large part of its original height.
The central tower had broken in several places during the battle with Two and parts of it had fallen into the courtyard.
But the crown was still the highest point of the ruins.
Lian climbed using the remaining walls, whenever the path was broken, he created a platform of ice.
Several times he was also forced to use Thunder Step to cross the distance between two broken sections.
The higher he went, the clearer the true size of the crown became and from close up, the structure was even stranger.
Eight curved black branches came out from the main ring.
Their material was neither completely metal nor bone and the surface of each branch was covered with very small spirals and in the center of each one, there was a mark that looked like a closed eye.
He finally stood in front of the base of the crown.
The Celestial Book of Treasure almost came out of his storage space by itself.
The pages turned quickly and Lian placed his hand on the central part of the structure, the purple light of the book became stronger.
[Final analysis completed.]
[Crown of Eight Paths]
[Rank: S.]
[Creator: Followers of the Divine of Chaos.]
[Usage requirement: 3000 spirit.]
He opened the explanation.
[Eightfold Seal]
[The crown can create up to eight independent seals.]
[The seals can be divided between several targets or placed on a single target at the same time.]
[Each seal suppresses the target or targets.]
[Placing multiple seals on one target increases the sealing power exponentially.]
[Placing all eight seals on one target forms the "Eightfold Restraint."]
[The power and duration of the seals depend on the user’s spirit, the target’s power and its resistance to restraint.]
[Targets with a much higher Level or spirit can break the seals with enough force.]

[The crown alone was not made to restrain extremely powerful creatures for a long period of time. Using fixed anchors and prepared arrays can greatly increase the power and duration of the restraint.]
Lian read the last part again.
So this explained how the followers of the Divine of Chaos had been able to keep Two imprisoned for such a long time.
It was not only the crown and in fact, the entire sanctuary was part of the prison.
Eight paths, eight chains, eight anchors and the crown as the central core had worked together as a prison for the Wolf Of Eight Disasters.
Something at the bottom of the explanation caught his attention.
[An Eightfold Restraint is still connected to the crown.]
[Target: Special Colony Member — Two.]
The young Vorhelm raised his eyebrows slightly.
Even though it had become his Colony Member, the original seals were still on its body.
This was probably also why during the battle, even after breaking several chains, it had not been able to truly escape the fortress’s range.
Another panel appeared.
[Warning.]
[Removing the crown from its base will end the active Eightfold Restraint.]
He remained silent for a few seconds, if Two were still his enemy, this warning would have been a major problem but now it was a Colony Member.
"Then even better."
His fingers closed around the crown’s central ring, he pulled it out of its base.
CRACK!
The first branch that went from the crown toward the ground broke.
The second.
The third.
Until the eighth.
At the same moment, Two opened its eyes, the eight black marks that remained on its chest, neck, legs and spine lit up at the same time.
Then they began to crack one after another.
CRACK!
The first seal broke.
Then the second.
Within a few seconds, all eight seals disappeared.
[The external restraint of Special Colony Member "Two" has ended.]
[All eight seals have been released.]
[Two is now completely free from the Eightfold Restraint.]
Lian felt something through the Colony Link..
For the first time after an unknown amount of time, Two had no chains on its body.
It was free, after such a long time it could finally feel what freedom was like again.
It turned toward its master, bowed deeply without any extra movement and showed its gratitude from the bottom of its heart.
One immediately raised its head and looked at this scene.
Lian also smiled and at that moment Two stood up and released a howl, its first howl after being freed.
Then, in his hand, the huge crown began to change, the eight branches slowly folded and the central ring became smaller.
In less than a minute, the structure that had once covered a large part of the tower turned into a black crown with eight points that could easily fit in both hands.
He examined it for a few moments, an S-rank artifact that only had one ability but that one ability could be very dangerous if used correctly.
In any case, it was powerful enough to imprison the Wolf Of Eight Disasters at its peak.
He placed the crown inside his storage space.
Lian had just wanted to go down when particles separated from the side of his body.
For a moment he thought it was a reaction from the crown, but he soon realized he was wrong.
The particles gathered in front of him and took the shape of an egg and when it was complete, the Devouring Egg was floating in front of him.
He looked at it for a few moments.
"Did you finally finish your favorite meal?"
The egg moved slightly and nodded happily, it had been taken care of very well for the past few days and was very, very happy.
[Devouring Egg.]
[Completion Process: 52%.]
The hundreds of corpses he had given it before entering Wolfgrave had pushed the embryo completion process forward by a considerable amount.
The egg moved slightly and then turned toward the bottom of the tower, exactly toward where the wolf corpses were lying on the ground.
Lian silently watched it for a few seconds.
"Are you still hungry?"
The egg moved again.
"I guessed." He let out a short sigh and pointed downward.
"Go. They are all yours, just let One take the cores."
The egg almost immediately went down from the edge, when it reached the corpses, dark threads came out from its shell.
The first thread entered the body of a wolf.
Then five threads.
Ten threads.
Very soon, the huge bodies began to dry up one after another.
Lian looked down from above for a moment, he could have made a lot of money by selling all these monster corpses, but he was giving all of them to the Devouring Egg for free.
He only hoped that when whatever was inside it was born, it would be worth it.
Then he came down from the tower.
One was busy with the cores, the Devouring Egg was busy with the corpses.
And Two, after being freed, was sent by its master into the Colony House to recover and heal.
And Lian finally had time to look around him, after all, this place had once been a civilization belonging to the followers of the Divine of Chaos.
He took out World Memory.
The map, which had been incomplete in many areas before, was now recovering more information because of his direct presence in the center of the ruins.
The first important building was only a few hundred meters from the fortress.
[Hall of Eight Answers.]
Lian entered.
A large part of the ceiling had collapsed, but the eight inner walls were still intact.
A different answer to the same question was written on each wall.
Most of the texts had disappeared but World Memory restored parts of them.
[Chaos is not destruction.]
[Chaos is the moment when more than one answer still remains.]
He looked at the sentence for a few seconds.
Interesting.
Even until today, whenever he heard the name Divine of Chaos, the first things that came to his mind were disorder, destruction and madness.
But its followers seemed to have a different understanding, to them, Chaos was something close to possibility.
Absolute order was something like one path, one answer, one future but Chaos was different and allowed a second path to still exist.
On another broken pillar, a sentence had remained.
[As long as a second path exists, fate is not a command.]
"So this was the principle of your religion, to some extent, it is like you were trying to defy fate." Lian read it calmly.

Then they began to crack one after another.
CRACK!
The first seal broke.
Then the second.
Within a few seconds, all eight seals disappeared.
[The external restraint of Special Colony Member "Two" has ended.]
[All eight seals have been released.]
[Two is now completely free from the Eightfold Restraint.]
Lian felt something through the Colony Link..
For the first time after an unknown amount of time, Two had no chains on its body.
It was free, after such a long time it could finally feel what freedom was like again.
It turned toward its master, bowed deeply without any extra movement and showed its gratitude from the bottom of its heart.
One immediately raised its head and looked at this scene.
Lian also smiled and at that moment Two stood up and released a howl, its first howl after being freed.
Then, in his hand, the huge crown began to change, the eight branches slowly folded and the central ring became smaller.
In less than a minute, the structure that had once covered a large part of the tower turned into a black crown with eight points that could easily fit in both hands.
He examined it for a few moments, an S-rank artifact that only had one ability but that one ability could be very dangerous if used correctly.
In any case, it was powerful enough to imprison the Wolf Of Eight Disasters at its peak.
He placed the crown inside his storage space.
Lian had just wanted to go down when particles separated from the side of his body.
For a moment he thought it was a reaction from the crown, but he soon realized he was wrong.
The particles gathered in front of him and took the shape of an egg and when it was complete, the Devouring Egg was floating in front of him.
He looked at it for a few moments.
"Did you finally finish your favorite meal?"
The egg moved slightly and nodded happily, it had been taken care of very well for the past few days and was very, very happy.
[Devouring Egg.]
[Completion Process: 52%.]
The hundreds of corpses he had given it before entering Wolfgrave had pushed the embryo completion process forward by a considerable amount.
The egg moved slightly and then turned toward the bottom of the tower, exactly toward where the wolf corpses were lying on the ground.
Lian silently watched it for a few seconds.
"Are you still hungry?"
The egg moved again.
"I guessed." He let out a short sigh and pointed downward.
"Go.
They are all yours, just let One take the cores."
The egg almost immediately went down from the edge, when it reached the corpses, dark threads came out from its shell.
The first thread entered the body of a wolf.
Then five threads.
Ten threads.
Very soon, the huge bodies began to dry up one after another.
Lian looked down from above for a moment, he could have made a lot of money by selling all these monster corpses, but he was giving all of them to the Devouring Egg for free.
He only hoped that when whatever was inside it was born, it would be worth it.
Then he came down from the tower.
One was busy with the cores, the Devouring Egg was busy with the corpses.
And Two, after being freed, was sent by its master into the Colony House to recover and heal.
And Lian finally had time to look around him, after all, this place had once been a civilization belonging to the followers of the Divine of Chaos.
He took out World Memory.
The map, which had been incomplete in many areas before, was now recovering more information because of his direct presence in the center of the ruins.
The first important building was only a few hundred meters from the fortress.
[Hall of Eight Answers.]
Lian entered.
A large part of the ceiling had collapsed, but the eight inner walls were still intact.
A different answer to the same question was written on each wall.
Most of the texts had disappeared but World Memory restored parts of them.
[Chaos is not destruction.]
[Chaos is the moment when more than one answer still remains.]
He looked at the sentence for a few seconds.
Interesting.
Even until today, whenever he heard the name Divine of Chaos, the first things that came to his mind were disorder, destruction and madness.
But its followers seemed to have a different understanding, to them, Chaos was something close to possibility.
Absolute order was something like one path, one answer, one future but Chaos was different and allowed a second path to still exist.
On another broken pillar, a sentence had remained.
[As long as a second path exists, fate is not a command.]
"So this was the principle of your religion, to some extent, it is like you were trying to defy fate." Lian read it calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 494: The Wolfgrave Fortresses ( Final )
paragraphs: After reading those texts, he also went to other parts of the Wolfgrave Fortresses and found several more ruined temples.
The same meaning was repeated in the other temples as well.
The eight Divine Eyes of Chaos were a symbol of seeing eight different possibilities.
The eight hands represented the ability to choose and touch different paths.
The endless spiral also showed that there was no final and unchangeable state.
Even in some writings, death was described as the "Final Order", the end of all possibilities, and apparently, some extreme branches of this religion had tried to reject even that.
This part made Lian stop for a moment, he knew a little about the Seven Divines, but seeing the religions and traditions that had once existed here was interesting to him.
The basic traditions were the same as the ones they had found in the previous Ruined Realms, but the interpretations were somewhat different.
It was normal, two people could get two different ideas from the same sentence.
The next building appeared on the map with another name.
[Temple of Unwalked Paths.]
Inside, more wall paintings had survived.
One of them caught his attention.
A wolf, but not something like the one he had fought a few hours ago, this wolf was large, perhaps twice the size of a normal one, but it still had a natural appearance.
Dark fur and two eyes, without any bones sticking out, and beside it stood eight humans wearing long ritual clothes.
[Guardian of the Eight Paths.]
Lian remained still for a moment.
"Two..." or at least that was the guess that came to his mind, but after moving forward, he realized that his guess had also been correct.
That monster had not always been the Eight Disasters, and in fact, it had once been the guardian of this place.
[Ritual identified.]
[Rite of Eight Possibilities.]
Lian read the damaged explanations, the purpose of the ritual was stranger than he had expected.

The followers of the Divine of Chaos wanted to force a living monster that they had managed to tame to follow eight different evolution paths at the same time instead of following only one evolution path.
For them, this was perhaps the purest proof of the philosophy of the Divine of Chaos.
The guardian wolf had been chosen for the ritual, and unlike what he had expected, the ritual had not failed.
It had succeeded.
Eight evolution paths had formed inside one body, but no living creature had been made to carry such things at the same time.
The paths collided with each other and the body began to change, eight eyes were formed.
Each evolution path turned into a huge transformation, and later they were called the "Eight Disasters".
Lian looked at the simple picture of the wolf on the wall.
"So you made it yourselves." But he had no idea how such a thing had been possible.
There was no information about what the ritual was or how it was performed.
But it did not make sense at all either, he had never heard that it was possible to interfere with the evolution path of monsters, and such a thing had never been seen in the previous Ruined Realms.
He had only seen one special example where someone’s evolution path had been changed, and that was Kain, and that was because he had absorbed the tear of the Divine Of Light.
But there was one connection between them, both that poor wolf and Kain had their evolution paths changed with the help of things that belonged to two Divines.
The next part of the information was darker.
The wolf’s body had started to show unholy features, maintaining eight paths required far more energy than its body could produce.
At first, it consumed meat, then blood, monster cores, and finally living creatures.

And it did not take long before it had lost control, that creature had been only a monster from the beginning that the followers of the Divine of Chaos had managed to tame, something similar to what some summoners could do.
Their goal in doing this was for the monster to protect them from other monsters.
But it should not be forgotten that in the end, it had been a monster that had turned into something that should not have been possible, and the final result was not good.
It had destroyed parts of the shelter and killed many of the same people it had once protected.
On the wall beside it, there was a broken stone inscription.
[We wanted to prove that no creature is trapped in a single destiny.]
[...but what we created no longer had a destiny that it could remain in.]
Lian stayed silent for a few seconds, that was a good sentence for admitting failure.
The next question was obvious, why had they not killed it?
The answer was in the deeper part of the temple, they had tried, several times, but after the eight paths had evolved, killing the wolf was no longer simple.
Every time one of the structures of its body was damaged, one of the other paths could change the situation of the battle.
And worse, the amount of energy stored inside it had become so great that completely destroying it inside the shelter could destroy a large part of the city along with it.
In the end, the eight High Priests had made another decision.
Instead of killing it, they sealed each of the paths.
And the Crown of the Eight Paths was the core that connected all the seals together.
The entire structure of the shelter was later changed to strengthen this one prison.
Young Vorhelm raised his head slightly.
"My guess was right, these Fortresses eventually changed from a city into a prison for this monster."

After all, it should not be forgotten that their world had been attacked by monsters, and it did not take long for this city to fall as well, and after the fall of the civilization, Two was still trapped inside the cage.
But it had been trapped for a very long time.
The monster had slowly understood the structure of the seal network.
And then it had done something that strangely matched the philosophy of the people who had imprisoned it.
It had found another path.
It could not break the seals directly, so it had reversed the network.
It had connected the wolf monsters around it to the network.
The pieces of black bone behind the necks of the Howlers were actually changed forms of the nodes of that same network.
Through them, it gave commands, gathered corpses, and sent biomass and the remaining mana into the network.
And then it used the prison system to eat its own prison.
Generation after generation and corpse after corpse, it took time until the seal erosion reached 43%.
If Lian had entered this area later, perhaps a few more years or a few more decades would have been enough for Two to escape without anyone’s help.
After all, he now understood why (Unholy) was written beside Rank Two, although it was still only a guess, he was somewhat sure.
That wolf had been a Fallen, the followers of the Divine of Chaos had managed to tame a Fallen, although it was amazing, it was not impossible either.
And the ritual they had performed on that monster had caused it to go beyond all Fallens, but it still had not truly become an Unholy.
And the system also did not know how it should rank it, so it had done it this way.
But this made him curious, was there something he could do to make Two become a true Unholy in the future?
This was a question he did not have an answer to for now.
A few hours later, the gray light of the sky had become weaker.
When he returned to the main field again, there were no more corpses, and the Devouring Egg had consumed them.
Only dry skins, useless bones, and a few pieces remained.
One was also standing beside the last group of cores.
[Multiple Monster Cores absorbed.]
[First Evolution Saturation: High.]
[The requirement for the First Evolution has not yet been completed.]
"Still not?" Lian looked at One.
One’s antennae moved, it was clear that he was not happy with this situation either, he could not wait to complete his first evolution.
Then he walked toward the Devouring Egg.
"It’s time to go."
The egg turned into tiny particles and joined his body again.
He looked at the ruins of the Wolfgrave Fortresses one last time and then opened the World Memory.
The path back to Base #9 was shown on the map.
When they passed through the hidden area, a small notification appeared in front of him.
[Wolfgrave Fortresses have been left.]
[The Pioneer of the Forgotten Realms regional feature has been deactivated.]
Young Vorhelm continued without stopping, and a few hours later, the lights of Base #9 appeared in the distance through the fog.
